sylphx.access.v1.AiSpendLimit.description:
AiSpendLimit caps Sylphx AI spend at the sell price, in USD cents. A day
and a month are UTC calendar periods.

daily_usd_minor.description: Most spend per calendar day, in USD cents.

monthly_usd_minor.description: Most spend per calendar month, in USD cents.

sylphx.access.v1.ApiKey.description:
An ApiKey is a credential of one environment, or an org-wide key of an
org (it acts on every project of the org), issued only by Access (the
platform has one key system). The secret is returned once, by Create and
Roll, and never again.

name.description:
`orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/api_keys/{api_key}`, or
`orgs/{org}/api_keys/{api_key}` for an org-wide key.

sylphx.access.v1.ApiKeyKind.description: ApiKeyKind is whether a key may be shipped to a browser.

sylphx.access.v1.ApiKeySpec.description: ApiKeySpec is the caller-writable state of an ApiKey.

expire_time.description: When the key stops verifying; required in unclaimed projects.

label.description: A free-form label, for example the talent id a key was minted for.

limits.description:
Usage limits on this key, on top of its project's and the plan tier's;
the tightest one applies. Unset means no key-level limit.

scopes.description: Scopes `<service>:<action>`, a subset of the creator's effective scopes.

sylphx.access.v1.ApiKeyStatus.description: ApiKeyStatus is the observed state of an ApiKey.

last4.description: The last four characters, for display.

last_use_ip.description: The client address of the key's last use.

last_use_time.description: When the key last verified, at snapshot granularity.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

revoke_time.description: Set when the key was revoked.

role_bound.description:
A device key (`sylphx login`): bound to the approving human's role in
the org, and revoked when that role changes or the human leaves.

secret.description: The full key. Set only in the responses of Create and Roll.

name.description: `orgs/{org}`.

sylphx.access.v1.OrgKind.description: OrgKind is how an Org came to exist (onboarding spec §3).

api_version.description:
The API version (`YYYY-MM-DD`) requests are served at when neither the

sylphx.access.v1.Project.description: A Project groups environments and the Resources in them.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}`.

sylphx.access.v1.ProjectSpec.description: ProjectSpec is the caller-writable state of a Project.

limits.description:
Usage limits shared by every key of the project; a key's own limits
only tighten them. Unset means no project-level limit.

sylphx.access.v1.ServiceEnablement.description:
A ServiceEnablement says whether one service is enabled on a Project: the
project's keys reach a service only while it is enabled (onboarding spec
§3.2). It is project-scoped, applies to every environment of the project,
and is named by the service id (`data`, `hosting`, ...): the rows are fixed
by the platform's service list, so there is no create or delete, and an
update writes `spec.enabled`.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/service_enablements/{service}`.

uid.description: The service id; equals the name segment.

sylphx.access.v1.ServiceEnablementSpec.description: ServiceEnablementSpec is the caller-writable state of a ServiceEnablement.

enabled.description: Whether the project's keys may reach the service.

sylphx.access.v1.ServiceEnablementStatus.description: ServiceEnablementStatus is the observed state of a ServiceEnablement.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

sylphx.access.v1.UsageLimits.description:
UsageLimits are the limits a customer sets on a key or a project. Each is
enforced before a call is served; a call over one is refused with
RATE_LIMITED or SPEND_LIMIT_REACHED and is not billed. An unset field sets
no limit at this level.

ai_tokens_per_minute.description: Sylphx AI tokens per minute, input and output together.

api_key.description: The API key that authenticated the request; empty for an OAuth token.

api_version.description:
The API version date applied to this request; empty before the first
version.

env.description: The environment the credential is scoped to; empty above an environment.

org.description: The org the credential is scoped to.

project.description: The project the credential is scoped to; empty for an org-wide credential.

sylphx.agents.v1.Agent.description:
An Agent is a versioned agent definition: model, instructions, tools, MCP
servers, skills, memory stores, tool policy and budget. Each create or
update that changes `spec` mints a new immutable AgentVersion; a session
pins the version it started on, so a change never alters a running
conversation.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}`.

spec.description: Desired state: the definition the next version takes.

sylphx.agents.v1.AgentBudget.description: AgentBudget caps what one turn and one session may spend.

max_session_spend_micros.description:
Spend per session in micro-USD, models and tools together; 0 is the
project's spend limit only.

max_steps_per_turn.description: Model and tool steps per turn, 1 to 1000; default 100.

turn_timeout.description: One turn's wall-clock deadline, 10s to 24h; default 30m.

sylphx.agents.v1.AgentSession.description:
An AgentSession is a durable conversation with one pinned AgentVersion.
Its conversation is its SessionEvent log. Each turn runs as one Sylphx
Workflows Run, and each model call and tool call is a step keyed by
`(session, turn, step)`, assigned by the runtime and never taken from the
model's tool-call id. An idle session holds no Run and no compute.

agent.description: The Agent the session talks to.

agent_version.description:
The AgentVersion the session pinned; the Agent's current version when
unset at create.

credentials.description:
Session-scoped credential bindings, keyed by the tool or MCP credential
name. Values are references or opaque handles, never secret values.

end_user.description:
The Sylphx Auth end user the session belongs to, set from the caller's
end-user session; empty for a session a secret key started. An end user
reads and changes only their own sessions.

environment.description:
The immutable effective environment for this session. RunAgent resolves it
from the pinned AgentVersion's frozen default and selected request overrides.
For CreateAgentSession, omission inherits the pinned default; an explicit
environment replaces it.

environment_lease.description: The Sylphx Sandboxes lease attached to the session, while it has one.

last_event_sequence.description: The sequence of the newest event, from 0.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/agent_sessions/{agent_session}`.

profiles.description:
Granted platform Profiles to mount when the session starts, each by
resource name and mode. The runtime never puts profile values in events.

title.description: A short title; set by the caller or summarised by the runtime.

turn_count.description: The number of turns started, from 0.

update_time.description: When the last event was appended.

usage.description: What the session has used so far.

sylphx.agents.v1.AgentSpec.description:
AgentSpec is the caller-writable definition of an Agent. An AgentVersion
holds a frozen copy of it.

budget.description: Spend and time limits per turn and per session.

end_user_access.description:
Whether end-user session access is intended for this agent. Reserved
until the backend enforces end-user ownership; all contract methods
currently require a secret key.

environment.description:
Default session environment (shell, files, browser, computer use), frozen
in each AgentVersion. RunAgent overlays only its selected environment
fields on that pinned default and requires a valid fresh finite lease.

harness.description:
The execution harness, independent of `model`: `runtime` (default),
`claude_code` or `codex`. It is part of the immutable version, not an
environment-wide setting. An omitted or empty value means `runtime`.

instructions.description: The system instructions, at most 256 KiB.

mcp_servers.description: The MCP servers whose tools the agent may call, at most 32.

memory_stores.description:
The memory stores the agent recalls from and writes to, as MemoryStore
names; at most 8.

model.description:
The exact Sylphx AI catalog id (`ai_models`), set per Agent through the
API as runtime state, never code or a deployed file. Agents in the same
environment may use different models; the harness never remaps this id.

skills.description: Skills: instruction packs the agent loads when relevant, at most 64.

tool_policy.description: The policy every tool call passes before it runs.

tools.description: The tools the agent may call, at most 128, each `name` once.

sylphx.agents.v1.AgentStatus.description: AgentStatus is the observed state of an Agent.

current_version.description: The newest version, which new sessions pin unless they name another.

current_version_number.description: The number of the newest version, from 1.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

sylphx.agents.v1.AgentVersion.description:
An AgentVersion is one immutable snapshot of an Agent's definition. It is
written by the create or update that changed the Agent's spec, and never
changed after.

agent_generation.description: The Agent generation that minted it.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}/agent_versions/{agent_version}`.

version_number.description: The version number within the agent, from 1, with no gaps.

sylphx.agents.v1.Approval.description: An Approval is a tool call the policy sent to a person, and its answer.

decision.description: The answer, once given; unset while it waits.

reason.description: The reason given, if any.

remember.description:
Whether the answer covers later calls of the same tool in this session
("always allow").

sylphx.agents.v1.ApprovalDecision.description: ApprovalDecision is a person's answer to an approval.

sylphx.agents.v1.BuiltinTool.description: A BuiltinTool is a tool the platform provides.

config.description: Tool-specific settings, at most 16 KiB of JSON.

sylphx.agents.v1.CaptureCredentialReques.description: Caller-owned grant capture; only opaque metadata is returned.

allowed_tools.description: Pinned tool names allowed to inject this credential.

credential.description: The existing caller-owned credential, stored encrypted and never logged.

expires_at.description: The issuer-provided expiry of the captured credential.

parent.description: The environment in which the caller holds the existing grant.

purpose.description: execution, completion, or runtime; runtime handles never enter the guest.

session.description: The prospective or existing session to bind this handle to.

turn.description: The turn allowed to use the execution credential.

sylphx.agents.v1.CatalogTool.description: A tool description embedded in a session catalog, not a named resource.

description.description: The tool description presented to the agent harness.

input_schema.description: The JSON Schema of the tool's validated input.

name.description: The tool name in the pinned agent version.

sylphx.agents.v1.ClientTool.description:
A ClientTool is a tool the client runs: the session waits for its result
in state `AWAITING_CLIENT`.

timeout.description:
How long the session waits for the result before the call fails, 1s to
24h; default 10m.

sylphx.agents.v1.CompletionCall.description: Completion uses a tool in the pinned version, never a caller-supplied URL.

arguments.description: Immutable literal tool input, excluding credentials and mapped result fields.

result_fields.description: Destination argument names mapped to runtime-produced result selectors.

tool.description: The authorized tool name in the pinned agent version.

sylphx.agents.v1.ContentPart.description: A ContentPart is one piece of a message.

file.description: A file, by Sylphx Data object URL or an https URL.

agent.description: The agent to create; only caller-writable fields are read.

agent_id.description:
The agent id, the final name segment; the server assigns one when
empty.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

agent_session.description: The session to create; only caller-writable fields are read.

agent_session_id.description:
The session id, the final name segment; the server assigns one when
empty.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

memory.description: The memory to create; only caller-writable fields are read.

memory_id.description:
The memory id, the final name segment; the server assigns one when
empty.

parent.description: The memory store to create in.

memory_store.description: The memory store to create; only caller-writable fields are read.

memory_store_id.description:
The memory store id, the final name segment; the server assigns one when
empty.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

sylphx.agents.v1.CredentialBinding.description:
A CredentialBinding names where the gateway takes a credential from. The
value is resolved at egress only; the model, the event log and traces see
the binding, never the value.

connection.description: A Kernel Connection (a third-party OAuth installation), by name.

end_user_provider.description:
The end user's own grant in Sylphx Auth's agent token vault, by
provider id; the session's end user must hold it.

handle.description:
An opaque credential handle issued for this session, resolved only at
egress. This is never a credential value.

placement.description:
How the value is sent: `bearer` (default), `header:<Name>` or
`query:<name>`.

secret.description: A Kernel Secret of this environment, by name.

sylphx.agents.v1.CredentialHandle.description: An opaque session-bound reference to a captured grant, not a CRUD resource.

expires_at.description: The issuer-provided expiry of the captured credential.

generation.description: The current fencing generation of the captured handle.

handle.description: The opaque handle; it never reveals the captured credential.

name.description: The name of the session.

reason.description: Why, at most 500 characters; the agent reads it with a rejection.

remember.description:
Also allow later calls of the same tool in this session without asking
("always allow"); only with APPROVE.

allow_missing.description: Succeed when the agent does not exist.

sylphx.agents.v1.EnvironmentSpec.description:
EnvironmentSpec describes a session's Sandboxes environment. The pinned
AgentVersion may provide a default. RunAgent overlays selected fields using
RunAgentRequest.environment_mask; an explicit environment on
CreateAgentSession replaces the default instead.

budget.description: The lease's CPU and cost ceiling, separate from model and tool spend.

egress.description: The lease's outbound policy, using the Sandboxes network contract.

idle_standby.description:
Put the environment in standby after this long idle, 1m to 24h; default
10m.

repo.description: The repository to prepare inside the fresh lease, if any.

shape.description: A Sylphx Sandboxes shape; empty gives sessions no environment.

template.description:
The Sandboxes image: `template:<name>` or an artifact image by digest,
passed unchanged to the lease's `image` field.

ttl.description:
The lease's maximum wall time, passed to Sandboxes as `ttl`. The lease
is released when the session ends even if this bound has not been reached.

sylphx.agents.v1.ErrorEvent.description: ErrorEvent is a step or harness failure, without credential values.

kind.description: The registry error code or harness error kind.

sylphx.agents.v1.FileChange.description: FileChange is a file changed by a step's harness.

added.description: Lines added, when reported by the harness.

old_path.description: The previous path, for a rename or copy.

path.description: The path relative to the session's repository root.

removed.description: Lines removed, when reported by the harness.

source.description: `edit` for an incremental edit or `final` for the turn's final diff.

sylphx.agents.v1.FileRef.description: A FileRef names a file attached to a message.

sylphx.agents.v1.FunctionTool.description: A FunctionTool is a tool whose logic is the app's own server code.

uri.description:
The HTTPS endpoint the gateway calls, a Hosting route or a verified
Network Domain of this project.

name.description: The name of the agent to get.

The name of the session event to get.

sylphx.agents.v1.HttpTool.description: An HttpTool is an HTTP API the gateway calls on the agent's behalf.

credential.description: The credential the gateway injects at egress; the model never sees it.

openapi.description: An OpenAPI 3 document, at most 1 MiB of JSON.

openapi_uri.description: An HTTPS URL of an OpenAPI 3 document.

operation_id.description:
The operation the tool calls; empty exposes every operation as its own
tool named `<tool>_<operationId>`.

name.description: The name of the session.

reason.description: Why, recorded on the status event; at most 500 characters.

sylphx.agents.v1.InvokeToolRequest.description: The request to execute one pinned tool through the session gateway.

arguments.description: The tool input, validated against its pinned input schema.

name.description: The name of the session whose pinned tools are used.

op_id.description: The stable operation identifier, reused for idempotent tool-call retries.

tool.description: The tool name in the session's pinned agent version.

turn.description: The live turn whose execution capability authorizes the call.

filter.description: AIP-160 filter, limited to `agent`, `end_user` and `state`.

page_size.description: At most this many; default 50, clamped to 1000.

next_page_token.description: The token of the next page; empty on the last page.

60s; unset answers at once.

next_page_token.description: The token of the next page; empty on the last page.

sylphx.agents.v1.McpServer.description: An McpServer is a remote MCP server whose tools the agent may call.

allowed_tools.description: Only these of its tools; empty allows every tool it lists.

credential.description: The credential the gateway presents to the server.

label.description: The label its tools are prefixed with, unique within the agent.

sylphx.agents.v1.Memory.description: A Memory is one long-term memory record: a fact with its provenance.

agent.description: The agent it belongs to, for a store scoped to agents.

content.description: The memory, at most 16 KiB of text.

end_user.description: The end user it is about, for a store scoped to end users.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/memory_stores/{memory_store}/memories/{memory}`.

sylphx.agents.v1.MemoryMatch.description: A MemoryMatch is one recalled memory and how well it matched.

sylphx.agents.v1.MemoryProvenance.description: MemoryProvenance records where a memory came from.

event.description: The event it was learned from, when an agent wrote it.

principal.description: The principal that wrote it, when a caller did.

session.description: The session it was learned in, when an agent wrote it.

sylphx.agents.v1.MemoryScope.description: MemoryScope is whose memories a store keeps apart.

sylphx.agents.v1.MemorySource.description: MemorySource is who wrote a memory.

sylphx.agents.v1.MemoryStore.description:
A MemoryStore holds long-term memory records with provenance, recalled by
hybrid full-text and vector search. Agents name the stores they use; a
store may be shared by many agents.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/memory_stores/{memory_store}`.

sylphx.agents.v1.MemoryStoreSpec.description: MemoryStoreSpec is the caller-writable state of a MemoryStore.

agent_writes.description:
Whether agents write memories themselves after each turn; otherwise
only callers write them.

description.description: What the store is for, shown to agents; at most 1024 characters.

retention.description:
Memories older than this since their last update are deleted, 1d to
3650d; unset keeps them until deleted.

sylphx.agents.v1.MemoryStoreStatus.description: MemoryStoreStatus is the observed state of a MemoryStore.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

stored_bytes.description: Bytes stored, content and index together; the billed quantity.

sylphx.agents.v1.Message.description: A Message is text and files from a user or the agent.

parts.description: The content, in order; 1 to 64 parts.

sylphx.agents.v1.PolicyDecision.description: PolicyDecision is what the tool policy does with a call.

sylphx.agents.v1.ProfileMount.description: ProfileMount attaches a platform Profile by name, never its sign-in values.

mode.description:
`read_only` (default) or `write_back`. Only a write_back grant saves
changes at session end while its lease still answers; empty is read_only.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/profiles/{profile}`.

sylphx.agents.v1.RenewalCall.description: A pinned tool called periodically while the accepted task owns its grant.

arguments.description: Immutable literal renewal-tool input, with credential injection by the gateway.

cancel_field.description: JSON pointers into the tool response; no domain-specific field names.

credential_expiries.description: Matching aliases to issuer-returned RFC3339 expiry response pointers.

credential_updates.description: Credential binding alias to a response JSON pointer for its replacement.

idempotency_argument.description:
Top-level argument receiving a stable per-tick runtime idempotency key.
Omit this argument from literal input; retries reuse it, later ticks change it.

interval.description: Positive interval, from five seconds to five minutes.

reason_field.description: A response JSON pointer selecting the cancellation reason.

tool.description: The authorized renewal tool name in the pinned agent version.

sylphx.agents.v1.RepositorySpec.description: RepositorySpec identifies the source to prepare in a session's lease.

revision.description: The commit or ref to check out; empty uses the repository's default branch.

uri.description: The repository URI. Access uses the session's bound credential handles.

sylphx.agents.v1.ResultField.description: Runtime-produced fields mapped into an authorized completion tool call.

sylphx.agents.v1.RevokeCredentialRequest.description: The request to revoke a captured credential handle.

handle.description: The opaque handle to revoke; repeated revocation is harmless.

parent.description: The environment that owns the captured handle.

sylphx.agents.v1.RotateCredentialRequest.description: The request to rotate a captured credential without changing its handle.

credential.description: The replacement issuer-provided credential, stored encrypted.

expires_at.description: The issuer-provided expiry of the replacement credential.

generation.description: The current handle generation; stale rotations are refused.

handle.description: The opaque handle whose captured credential is being replaced.

parent.description: The environment that owns the captured handle.

sylphx.agents.v1.RunAgentRequest.description: Immutable task-attempt input; the caller pins its own task/profile context.

agent_session_id.description: The stable session identifier; reusing it for another attempt is refused.

agent_version.description: The immutable agent version pinned for this task attempt.

completion.description: The pinned tool call used by the runtime to deliver the terminal result.

credentials.description: Captured credential bindings by alias; credentials never enter context.

environment.description:
Optional overrides of the environment in the pinned AgentVersion's frozen
spec, never the Agent's current head. Omitted or empty with no mask keeps
that default unchanged. Only selected fields are overlaid; see
environment_mask. The effective environment must have a supported shape,
finite positive TTL and valid repository, network and budget before admission.

environment_mask.description:
Fields of environment to overlay, relative to EnvironmentSpec, using proto
snake_case paths such as ttl, repo.uri, repo.revision,
egress.allowed_domains and budget.max_cost_micros. The wire value is a
comma-separated string; SDK property naming does not change these paths.
Omitted or empty infers populated serialized leaf fields recursively,
preserving unselected siblings from the pinned version. Proto defaults
(including empty lists) need an explicit mask to reset a selected field.
Selected lists replace, rather than append to, the inherited list.
The sole path "*" replaces the whole environment, resetting unpopulated
fields. Unknown, invalid and output-only paths are rejected, as is a
nonempty mask without environment. Effective validation also applies to
explicit resets and whole-environment replacement.

message.description: The initial task message appended atomically with session acceptance.

name.description: The name of the agent to run under the caller's environment grant.

profiles.description: Granted profile mounts for the fresh session lease.

renewal.description: Optional pinned grant-renewal call, owned by the runtime after acceptance.

runtime_credential_handle.description:
Same-session handle to a caller-owned scoped Access credential. Runtime only,
never installed in the guest or sent to the model.

task_ref.description: Caller-owned opaque reference, not interpreted by Agents.

workspace_knowledge.description: Opaque, claim-pinned workspace knowledge, including its rendered instruction.

sylphx.agents.v1.RunAgentResponse.description: Durable acceptance, not task completion or sandbox readiness.

cleanup.description: Lease-cleanup progress; released requires terminal lease evidence.

delivery.description: Result-delivery progress, independent of lease cleanup.

initial_event.description: The initial message event committed with the session and pending turn.

session.description: The durably accepted session; acceptance is not task completion.

end_user.description: Only memories about this end user.

page_size.description: At most this many; default 10, clamped to 100.

next_page_token.description: The token of the next page; empty on the last page.

name.description: The name of the session.

sylphx.agents.v1.SessionEvent.description:
A SessionEvent is one entry of a session's append-only log: a user
message, model output, a tool call or result, an approval, or a status
change. Events are never changed or reordered; `sequence` is their order.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/agent_sessions/{agent_session}/session_events/{session_event}`.

response.description: For RESPONSE: the completed turn's answer and usage.

sequence.description: The position in the session's log, from 1, with no gaps.

step.description:
The step within the turn, from 1, assigned by the runtime; 0 for an
event that is not a step.

thought.description: For THOUGHT: a reasoning summary, never private model reasoning.

turn.description: The turn it belongs to, from 1; 0 for an event outside a turn.

sylphx.agents.v1.SessionEventType.description: SessionEventType is what a session event records.

sylphx.agents.v1.SessionState.description: SessionState is where a session is.

sylphx.agents.v1.SessionUsage.description:
SessionUsage is what a session has used. Model tokens are on the Sylphx AI
meter; this is the Agents part.

gateway_calls.description: Tool calls made through the gateway.

spend_micros.description: Spend so far in micro-USD, models and tools together.

sylphx.agents.v1.Skill.description:
A Skill is an instruction pack the agent loads when its description
matches the task.

description.description: When to use it, shown to the model; at most 1024 characters.

instructions.description: The instructions it loads, at most 256 KiB.

name.description: The skill's name, unique within the agent.

sylphx.agents.v1.StatusChange.description: A StatusChange is the session moving to a new state.

reason.description: Why, for FAILED and INTERRUPTED: a registry error code and message.

name.description: The name of the session.

error.description: Whether the call failed; `output` then holds the error.

name.description: The name of the session.

output.description: The result, at most 1 MiB of JSON.

sylphx.agents.v1.Tool.description:
A Tool is one tool an agent may call. Every call goes through the tool
gateway: the policy check, credential injection at egress (the model, the
event log and traces see a handle, never the value), the egress guard, and
one usage record and trace span per call.

app_function.description:
The app's own server code: the gateway calls it with a short-lived
signed token bound to the session, turn and step.

client.description:
Run by the client: the app executes it and returns the result as an
event (`:submitToolResult`).

description.description: What the tool does, shown to the model; at most 4096 characters.

http.description: An HTTP API described by OpenAPI.

input_schema.description: The JSON Schema of the tool's input. Built-in tools carry their own.

name.description: The name the model calls, unique within the agent.

sylphx.agents.v1.ToolCall.description:
A ToolCall is the agent asking to call a tool. `id` is assigned by the
runtime; the model's own tool-call id is kept only as `model_call_id`, so
a model that repeats an id never collides two calls.

client.description: Whether the client runs it (a ClientTool).

id.description: The call's id within the session, `(turn, step)` based.

input.description: The input, as the model sent it.

model_call_id.description: The model's own id for the call, as sent; never used as a key.

sylphx.agents.v1.ToolCatalogRequest.description: The request for the tools available to a session execution capability.

name.description: The name of the session whose pinned tool catalog is requested.

sylphx.agents.v1.ToolCatalogResponse.description: The tool catalog visible to the authorized session execution capability.

tools.description: The tools in the session's pinned version, with no credential values.

sylphx.agents.v1.ToolPolicy.description:
A ToolPolicy decides each tool call before it runs. A grant is the
authorization: the policy asks a person only for a call no existing grant
covers. An OAuth scope, a credential bound to the tool, or an earlier
"always allow" is that grant.

approval_timeout.description:
How long a call waits for a person's answer before it is denied, 1m to
7d; default 24h.

default_decision.description: The decision for a call no rule matches; default allow.

egress_allow_hosts.description:
Hosts every network call of the agent's tools may reach, beyond the
tools' own endpoints; `*.example.com` matches subdomains. Private and
internal addresses are refused whatever this says.

rules.description: Rules in order; the first match decides. At most 256.

sylphx.agents.v1.ToolPolicyRule.description: A ToolPolicyRule matches tool calls by tool name.

condition.description:
A CEL condition over the call's `input`, the session's `end_user` and
`labels`; the rule matches only when it is true. Empty always matches.

tool.description:
A tool name, `<mcp label>__<tool>` for an MCP tool; `*` matches any
characters.

sylphx.agents.v1.ToolResult.description: A ToolResult is the outcome of one tool call.

error.description: Whether the call failed; `output` then holds the error.

sylphx.agents.v1.TurnResult.description: TurnResult is a completed turn's response, usage and duration.

is_error.description: Whether the turn ended with an error.

usage.description: Model token usage reported by the harness.

sylphx.agents.v1.TurnTokenUsage.description: TurnTokenUsage is the model token usage reported for a completed turn.

cache_read_tokens.description: Input tokens read from the model's cache.

cache_write_tokens.description: Input tokens written to the model's cache.

agent.description: The agent to update; `name` identifies it.

allow_missing.description: Create the agent when it does not exist (declarative upsert).

update_mask.description: The fields to write; unset writes every populated field.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

memory.description: The memory to update; `name` identifies it.

update_mask.description: The fields to write; unset writes every populated field.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

allow_missing.description: Create the memory store when it does not exist (declarative upsert).

memory_store.description: The memory store to update; `name` identifies it.

update_mask.description: The fields to write; unset writes every populated field.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

sylphx.ai.v1.AiModel.description:
An AI Model is one admitted entry of the Sylphx AI catalog: a model id a
caller may name on the inference surface, with its sell prices, limits, and
data policy. Only admitted models list (AI-CATALOG-ADMISSION); no
capability, contract, connector, or upstream price appears on an entry
(AI-CATALOG-NO-LEAK). The id is the canonical model id with `/` and `.`
written as `-`, for example `anthropic-claude-opus-5`; `model` carries the
canonical id itself.

The catalog is platform-wide and written only by `sylphx-platform`;
customers read it.

aliases.description:
Bare spellings that resolve to this model when unique, for example
`claude-opus-5`.

api_surfaces.description: Inference encodings the model answers on.

caching.description:
How long a prompt-cache prefix stays warm on this model, and the longest
retention a request may ask for; unset when no serving lane declares it.

data_policy.description: How request and response data are retained and used.

input_modalities.description: Accepted input modalities, for example text and image.

model.description:
The canonical model id, `brand/model`, for example
`anthropic/claude-opus-5`.

name.description: `ai_models/{ai_model}`.

preview.description: Whether the model is a preview.

price_identity.description: The price identity usage events carry, for example `spv3-...`.

prices.description: Sell prices per meter and class; the only prices on an entry.

sylphx.ai.v1.ApiSurface.description:
An inference encoding of the compatibility surface (ai-inference-surface.md
§5).

sylphx.ai.v1.DataPolicy.description: How a model's request and response data are handled.

response_retention.description: Stored responses expire after this long (7 days).

retains_prompts.description: Whether Sylphx or the upstream retains prompts beyond the request.

trains_on_prompts.description: Whether the upstream may train on prompts.

name.description: The name of the AI model to get.

filter.description: AIP-160 filter over labels and filterable fields.

page_size.description: At most this many; default 50, clamped to 1000.

next_page_token.description: The token of the next page; empty on the last page.

sylphx.ai.v1.ModelCaching.description: A model's prompt-cache retention, from its serving lanes' declarations.

extended_ttl.description:
The longest retention a request may ask for with
`prompt_cache_retention: "24h"`, for example one hour on a lane whose
longest native breakpoint is one hour; zero when no longer retention
exists. A prefix written at this retention bills at the `cache_write_1h`
price.

ttl.description:
How long a cached prefix stays warm after its last use with the default
retention, for example 300 seconds.

sylphx.ai.v1.ModelPrice.description: One sell price of a model.

price_class.description:
The meter dimension class, for example `input`, `cached_input`, `output`,
`reasoning`, `cache_write` (writing a prompt-cache prefix at the default
retention), or `cache_write_1h` (writing it at the extended retention).

unit.description: The unit the price is per, for example `1M tokens` or `image`.

unit_price.description: The price as a decimal string, for example `1.2`; never a float.

sylphx.artifacts.v1.Artifact.description:
An Artifact is one immutable content object addressed by digest: an
image, or evidence about one (an SBOM, a provenance attestation, a
signature) that names it as its subject.

builder.description: The builder identity (a SPIFFE id) that produced it.

digest.description:
The algorithm-qualified digest of the stored bytes, for example
`sha256:4f1c…`.

legal_hold.description: A legal hold is active; Delete fails.

name.description:
`orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/artifacts/{artifact}`, where `{artifact}`
is the digest with `-` for `:`, for example `sha256-4f1c…`.

provenance.description: The newest provenance attestation whose subject is this Artifact.

reference.description:
The OCI reference by digest to pull, for example
`registry.sylphx.com/<project>@sha256:4f1c…`.

regions.description: The regions the bytes are replicated to.

retention.description: How long the Artifact is kept.

sbom.description: The newest SBOM whose subject is this Artifact.

size_bytes.description: The size of the stored bytes.

source_digests.description: Digests of the sources and inputs that produced it.

subject.description: The Artifact this one describes, for an SBOM, provenance, or signature.

verification_state.description:
Whether the signature and provenance verified. Evidence, never
identity: a failure does not change the digest.

sylphx.artifacts.v1.ArtifactKind.description: ArtifactKind is what an Artifact is.

artifact.description: The artifact to create; only spec and caller-writable metadata are read.

artifact_id.description:
The id of the new artifact, the digest with `-` for `:`; the server derives it from `digest` when empty; the server assigns one when
empty.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

etag.description: Delete only if the current etag matches.

name.description: The name of the artifact to delete.

validate_only.description: Validate without deleting anything.

name.description: The name of the artifact to get.

filter.description: AIP-160 filter over labels and filterable fields.

page_size.description: At most this many; default 50, clamped to 1000.

next_page_token.description: The token of the next page; empty on the last page.

sylphx.artifacts.v1.RetentionClass.description: RetentionClass is how long an Artifact is kept.

sylphx.artifacts.v1.VerificationState.description: VerificationState is the result of verifying an Artifact.

content_hash.description: The content hash of the variant, 64 lowercase hex characters.

name.description: The name of the asset.

sylphx.assets.v1.Asset.description:
An Asset is one declared asset and its generated variants. Its id is the
16-hex logical key of the recipe, so the same recipe is always the same
Asset. There is no create, update or delete: the key is immutable, and
`:generate` writes the record.

canonical.description: The exact text the key is the hash of.

create_time.description: When the asset was first generated.

key.description: The logical key: 16 lowercase hex characters computed from the recipe.

kind.description: What kind of asset this is.

name.description:
`orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/assets/{asset}`, where `{asset}`
is the 16-hex logical key.

recipe.description: The recipe the asset was declared with.

seed.description: The seed of the asset, a decimal integer as a string.

state.description: Where the asset is in its life.

variants.description: The stored variants, ordered by slot.

variants_wanted.description: How many variants the recipe asks for.

sylphx.assets.v1.AssetKind.description: AssetKind is what an asset is.

sylphx.assets.v1.AssetRecipe.description:
An AssetRecipe is what the code declares for one asset. The logical key is
derived from it.

character_id.description:
The character this asset shows; only for `ASSET_KIND_CHARACTER`, encoded
in the canonical text as `id=`.

key.description:
The key the caller computed, 16 lowercase hex characters. When it differs
from the server's, the call is refused with `INVALID_FIELD` and the
problem carries the server's canonical text, which catches encoder drift.

kind.description: What kind of asset to make.

locale.description: The locale of the asset, a BCP 47 tag; empty for images.

params.description:
Kind-specific parameters in canonical text form, such as `"2"`,
`"1024x768"`, `"true"` or a 16-hex key. At most 16 pairs; keys are
`[a-z_]` up to 32 characters, values up to 256 characters.

prompt.description: What to make, at most 8000 bytes. Empty only for `ASSET_KIND_CHARACTER`.

sylphx.assets.v1.AssetState.description: AssetState is where an asset is in its life.

sylphx.assets.v1.AssetSummary.description: An AssetSummary is the progress of one asset in a `:generate` call.

name.description: The asset's resource name.

state.description: Where the asset is in its life.

variants_wanted.description: How many variants the recipe asks for.

filter.description:
AIP-160 filter, limited to `kind` and `review_state`; for example
`kind = ASSET_KIND_IMAGE`. Without a `review_state` term, rejected and
retired variants are left out.

page_size.description: At most this many items; default 100, clamped to 1000.

manifest_digest.description:
On the last page only: `sha256:` and the hex SHA-256 of the `content_hash`
of every item the filter matches (one line per item, sorted, each ended
by a line feed). A client that downloaded every page recomputes it from
the items it holds.

next_page_token.description: The token of the next page; empty on the last page.

sylphx.assets.v1.ExportedAsset.description:
An ExportedAsset is one variant in the flat export manifest. Download the
bytes from `url` and check them against `content_hash`.

approved_by.description: Who approved the variant; empty until approved.

asset_key.description: The logical key of the asset the variant belongs to.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the file, 64 lowercase hex characters.

ext.description: The file extension, without the dot.

review_state.description: The human review of the variant.

seed.description: The seed, an unsigned decimal string.

url.description: The public, content-addressed, immutable download URL.

recipes.description: The recipes the code declares; 1 to 1000.

validate_only.description:
Validate the recipes and return the counts without writing or
generating anything.

assets.description: One summary per recipe, in the order sent.

failed.description: Assets whose slots still fail after their attempts.

pending.description: Variants still to generate; call again until it is 0.

refused.description: Assets refused, for example by moderation.

unchanged.description: Assets that already existed with the same key.

unsupported.description: Assets of a kind the service does not generate yet.

name.description: The name of the asset to get.

filter.description:
AIP-160 filter, limited to `kind`, `state`, and `review_state`; for
example `kind = ASSET_KIND_IMAGE AND state = ASSET_STATE_READY`.

page_size.description: At most this many; default 50, clamped to 1000.

next_page_token.description: The token of the next page; empty on the last page.

keys.description:
The logical keys the code declares, 1 to 5000, each 16 lowercase hex
characters. The lock holds only these, so a removed recipe drops out.

entries.description: The lock entries of the keys that have a complete record, sorted by key.

incomplete.description:
Keys whose stored variants are fewer than wanted, or whose state is
neither ready nor approved.

sylphx.assets.v1.LockEntry.description: A LockEntry is one asset as it appears in `assets.lock`.

kind.description: What kind of asset this is.

seed.description: The seed, a decimal integer as a string.

sylphx.assets.v1.LockVariant.description:
A LockVariant is one variant as it appears in `assets.lock`. Its URL is the
lock's base URL, the content hash, a dot, and the extension.

approved_by.description: The principal that approved the variant; empty when unreviewed.

content_hash.description: The SHA-256 of the file's bytes, 64 lowercase hex characters.

ext.description: The file's extension without the dot.

model.description: The model that made this variant.

sylphx.assets.v1.QaFinding.description: A QaFinding is one problem QA found in a variant.

sylphx.assets.v1.QaSeverity.description: QaSeverity is how serious a QA finding is.

sylphx.assets.v1.QaState.description: QaState is the QA result of a variant.

content_hash.description: The content hash of the variant, 64 lowercase hex characters.

name.description: The name of the asset.

content_hash.description: The content hash of the variant, 64 lowercase hex characters.

name.description: The name of the asset.

reason.description: Why the variant is retired, at most 500 characters.

sylphx.assets.v1.ReviewState.description: ReviewState is the human review of a variant.

sylphx.assets.v1.Usage.description: Usage is what one call consumed.

images.description: Images stored by this call, the billed quantity.

sylphx.assets.v1.Variant.description:
A Variant is one stored result for an asset: a file addressed by the hash of
its bytes. A variant is immutable; only its review changes.

approved_by.description: The principal that approved the variant; empty until it is approved.

content_credentials.description: Whether the file carries content credentials.

content_hash.description: The SHA-256 of the file's bytes, 64 lowercase hex characters.

ext.description: The file's extension without the dot, such as `png`.

media_type.description: The file's media type, such as `image/png`.

model.description: The model that made this variant.

qa_state.description: The result of QA on the file.

review_state.description: The human review of the variant.

seed.description: The seed this variant was made with, a decimal integer as a string.

slot.description: The slot the variant fills, from 0.

url.description:
The immutable public URL: the project's base URL, then the content hash
and extension.

end_user.description: The accepting end user; its verified email must be the invited address.

name.description: The name of the invitation.

external_id.description:
The id itself, 1 to 128 printable characters, unique in its namespace
across the environment's live users.

name.description: The name of the end user.

namespace.description: The customer's namespace for this id: `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$`.

sylphx.auth.v1.AuthConfig.description:
An Auth Config is the app scope of Sylphx Auth in one environment: which
sign-in methods the customer's app offers, and its MFA, passkey, lockout,
session, CAPTCHA, and Account Portal policy. Every Auth fact is scoped to
one `orgs/{o}/projects/{p}/envs/{e}`; an environment has exactly one Auth
Config, id `default`.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/auth_configs/{auth_config}`.

sylphx.auth.v1.AuthConfigSpec.description: AuthConfigSpec is the caller-writable state of an AuthConfig.

auth_methods.description: Sign-in methods offered to end users.

captcha_secret.description:
The CAPTCHA verifier secret, held in Sylphx Secrets; unset disables
CAPTCHA.

lockout_enabled.description: Progressive lockout by user and IP.

mail_sending_domain.description:
The Notify Sending Domain Auth mail is sent from; unset uses the Sylphx
default.

mfa_required.description: Require a second factor for every end user.

social_providers.description:
Social sign-in: one entry per provider Sylphx serves (`google`, `github`,
`apple`), whether it is on, and whether end users can use it now. An
update changes only the providers it lists; the others keep their state.
Without any change Google is on through Sylphx's shared client, when
Sylphx has one. The provider's credentials (the shared client, or your
own client id and secret) are set with the instance's
`sign-in-providers:put`: a client secret never passes through this
resource.

test_email_pattern.description:
The address pattern of this environment's test accounts (a regular
expression over the whole lower-cased address); unset means the
environment has none. It must end in `@` and one of the environment's
DNS-verified customer-organization domains, escaped
(`qa\+[a-z0-9-]{1,40}@example\.com`), and must not match
`probe@example.com`; it is stored as `^(?:<local part>)@<domain>$`. An
end user is a test account (`synthetic_time`) only when it signed up
with a matching address and proved that address by a link or code;
changing the pattern never makes an existing end user one.

user_sync_database.description: A Sylphx Data database end users are synced into; unset disables sync.

sylphx.auth.v1.AuthConfigStatus.description: AuthConfigStatus is the observed state of an AuthConfig.

issuer_uri.description: The OAuth issuer URI; tokens verify from its JWKS.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

portal_origin.description: The Account Portal origin in use.

customer_organization.description: The customer organization to create; only caller-writable fields are read.

customer_organization_id.description:
The customer organization id, the final name segment; the server assigns
one when empty.

owner_end_user.description:
The organization's first owner, an active end user of the same
environment. The organization and its `owner` membership are created in
one transaction, and the call honours `Idempotency-Key`: a retry returns
the organization the first call created. Naming a person is explicit app
authority: the app vouches for its own tenant. Empty creates an
organization without members; creating then calling `CreateMembership` is
not atomic.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

email_domain.description: The email domain to create; only caller-writable fields are read.

email_domain_id.description:
The email domain id, the final name segment; the server assigns one when
empty.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

end_user.description: The end user to create; only caller-writable fields are read.

end_user_id.description:
The end user id, the final name segment; the server assigns one when
empty.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

invitation.description: The invitation to create; only caller-writable fields are read.

invitation_id.description:

A Customer Organization is a B2B tenant inside a customer's app. It is never
a Sylphx org and never a Resource name segment of anything but its own
memberships.

sylphx.auth.v1.EmailDomain.description:
An Email Domain is an email domain a customer organization claims. It is verified
by a DNS TXT record; a verified domain appears in the organization's
`verified_domains`, and one environment's organizations never verify the
same domain twice.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/customer_organizations/{customer_organization}/email_domains/{email_domain}`.

verification_record.description: The TXT record name to publish, `_sylphx-verification.<domain>`.

verification_value.description: The TXT record value to publish.

verify_time.description: When the record was last found.

sylphx.auth.v1.EmailDomainState.description: The verification state of an Email Domain.

sylphx.auth.v1.EndUser.description:
An End User is a user of a customer's app, never a Sylphx member or
principal. `(scope, email)` is unique among live end users. Delete is
revocation: it revokes every session and refuses new ones.

external_ids.description:
The customer's own ids for this end user, one per namespace
(`game_user`, `steam_id`): how an app that signs users in by its own id
finds them again. Read on create; never changed through here, because a
set namespace's value is never rewritten — `AttachEndUserExternalId` sets
an unset one. At most four namespaces. Never an authorization input:
scope checks use grant ids.

lock_expire_time.description:
Until when sign-in is locked after repeated failures; unset when not
locked. Unlock clears it; a suspension is `state`, not a lock.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/end_users/{end_user}`.

password.description: An initial password; write-only, checked against breached passwords.

private_metadata.description: App data readable only with an Access key.

public_metadata.description: App data readable by the end user's own tokens.

synthetic_time.description:
When the end user became a test account: set once, when an end user who
signed up with an address matching the Auth config's
`test_email_pattern` first proved that address by a link or code. No
update, import, address change or sign-in method ever sets it; changing
the address clears it. Unset for every other end user.

unsafe_metadata.description:
App data the end user may write with their own session (preferences a
sign-up form collects); never trust it for authorization.

sylphx.auth.v1.EndUserState.description: The lifecycle state of an end user.

namespace.description: The customer's namespace of the id.

end_user.description: The end user holding the id.

sylphx.auth.v1.Identity.description:
An Identity is one way an end user signs in: a password, a verified email, a
federated provider account, a device credential (a guest account's secret),
or a passkey. An end user always keeps at least one. An identity moves from
one end user to another only by `:move`, an operator action; the end user
never does it. It shows a fingerprint (a one-way digest), never the secret.

fingerprint.description:
A one-way digest of the provider and the provider's subject (or of the
device credential's verifier). It identifies the identity in an audit
trail and reveals neither.

last_use_time.description: The last sign-in with this identity, when known.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/end_users/{end_user}/identities/{identity}`.

provider.description:
The provider of a federated identity (`google`, `apple`, ...); empty
otherwise.

type.description: What kind of sign-in this is.

sylphx.auth.v1.Invitation.description:
An Invitation asks one email address to join a customer organization with
roles. It is single-use and expires; accepting needs an end user whose
verified email is the invited address, and creates the membership.

end_user.description: The end user who accepted it.

expire_time.description: When it expires.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/customer_organizations/{customer_organization}/invitations/{invitation}`.

roles.description: Roles the membership gets; empty means the environment's default roles.

ttl.description: How long it stays open; default 7 days, at most 30.

sylphx.auth.v1.Membership.description:
A Membership places an end user in a customer organization with app-defined
roles. Roles are app data, not Access policy. Changes append to history with
a current head per (user, organization); Delete closes the membership.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/customer_organizations/{customer_organization}/memberships/{membership}`.
The name of the identity to move.

reason.description: Why the identity moves (1 to 512 characters); recorded in the audit trail.

target_end_user.description: The end user that receives the identity.

sylphx.auth.v1.OauthClient.description:
An OAuth Client is a relying party of the customer's authorization server:
its app, API, or CLI. Tokens are signed by a Sylphx Keys handle and verify
offline from the published JWKS.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/oauth_clients/{oauth_client}`.

The client secret, for `client_secret_basic`; set only in the responses of
Create and RollSecret.

client_secret_last4.description: The last four characters of the client secret.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

sylphx.auth.v1.OrganizationRole.description:
An Organization Role is an app-defined role of the environment's customer
organizations: a key that memberships and invitations name, a display name
(`meta.display_name`), and the app's own permission strings. Roles are app
data, not Access policy. `owner`, `admin`, and `member` are built in and
need no Organization Role.

auto_assign.description: Whether new members and invitations without roles get this role.

permissions.description:
The app's permission strings `<resource>:<action>`, for example
`invoices:read` or `org:payroll:approve`.

aaguid_allowlist.description: Allowed authenticator AAGUIDs; empty allows any.

required.description: Require a passkey for every end user.

custom_domain.description:
A verified Network Domain serving the portal; unset uses the default
origin.

sylphx.auth.v1.Session.description:
A Session is an opaque Auth session of an end user, issued by a sign-in
ceremony. Sessions are revoked, never deleted; revocation is a CAEP signal
delivered through Sylphx Events.

expire_time.description: When the session expires.

mfa.description: Whether a second factor was presented.

fingerprint_binding.description: Bind sessions to network and agent; a mismatch demands step-up.

idle_timeout.description: Revoke after this long without use; default 30d.

max_concurrent_sessions.description:
Concurrent sessions per end user; excess sessions are revoked, oldest
first. 0 is unlimited.

enabled.description:
Whether the provider is offered. Turning one on needs credentials:
Sylphx's shared client for that provider, or your own.

usable.description:

sylphx.billing.v1.BillingAccount.description:
A BillingAccount is an org's plan subscription and payment standing: the
plan it is on, its spend limit, and its billing period. Each org has
exactly one, `orgs/{org}/billing_accounts/default`, created with the org.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/billing_accounts/default`.

sylphx.billing.v1.BillingAccountSpec.description: BillingAccountSpec is the caller-writable state of a BillingAccount.

billing_email.description: Where invoices and payment notices are sent.

credit_limit.description:
The reviewed invoice receivable limit, USD. Unset/null on approved invoice
terms means unlimited and never suspended. Finite limits retain net-term
dunning. Writing requires billing:terms:approve; a self cap is separate.

invoice_terms_approved.description:
Credit approval is an ordinary account setting, not a company flag.
Writing this field requires billing:terms:approve in addition to admin.

invoice_terms_days.description:
Net days from finalization, 1..365. Changes require billing:terms:approve
and affect only newly finalized invoices, never frozen history.

payment_method.description: Collection choice: `card` (default), or `invoice` with approved net terms.

plan.description:
The public plan, for example `plans/pro`. Card accounts activate Pro by
payment; approved invoice accounts may select it without a card.

spend_limit.description:
The customer's monthly cap on usage past included amounts. A lower cap
is always enforced independently of the seller's reviewed credit limit.

unlimited_spend.description: Clears the self spend cap; never lifts a tier or reviewed credit limit.

sylphx.billing.v1.BillingAccountState.description: BillingAccountState is an org's payment standing.

sylphx.billing.v1.BillingAccountStatus.description: BillingAccountStatus is the observed state of a BillingAccount.

currency_code.description: The currency every invoice of the org is in, ISO 4217.

effective_spend_limit.description:
The spend limit in force, after the default is applied; unset when
unlimited.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

payment_method.description:
The default payment method, for example `visa •••• 4242`; empty when
none is saved.

payment_method_verified.description: A payment method is on file and verified.

period_end_time.description: The end of the current billing period.

period_start_time.description: The start of the current billing period.

plan_version.description: The plan version the org is on, for example `2026-11-02`.

sylphx.billing.v1.BudgetLease.description:
A BudgetLease is budget Billing pre-authorized for one holder to spend
on hard-spend usage without calling Billing per request. Readable by the
org; written only by Billing.

dimensions.description: The lease key: the meter's required dimensions.

expire_time.description: When the holder stops debiting the lease.

fence.description:
The fence: monotonic per org, holder, and lease key; a renewal carrying
an older value is refused.

granted_nano_usd.description:
Billing's valuation of the grant at list price, in nano-USD; 0 for a
class Sylphx runs but does not sell.

granted_quantity.description: The units granted, in the meter's base unit.

holder.description:
The holder: a SPIFFE role and cell, for example
`services/sandboxes/cells/fs01`.

meter.description:
The leased meter. A lease is in the meter's units: the holder never
holds a price, Billing prices each grant from its price book.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/budget_leases/{budget_lease}`.

reported_debit_nano_usd.description: The debit the holder reported on renew or release, in nano-USD.

reported_debit_quantity.description: The units the holder reported on renew or release.

settled_debit_nano_usd.description: The debit rated from ingested usage, in nano-USD.

settled_quantity.description: The units ingested usage attributes to the lease.

sylphx.billing.v1.BudgetLeaseState.description: BudgetLeaseState is the lifecycle state of a BudgetLease.

sylphx.billing.v1.CreditNote.description: CreditNote is an append-only correction of a finalized invoice.

issue_time.description: When the credit note was issued.

reason.description: A customer-safe reason.

name.description: The name of the billing account to get.
The name of the budget lease to get.
The name of the invoice to get.
The name of the meter to get.
The name of the plan to get.
The name of the usage report to get.

sylphx.billing.v1.Invoice.description:
An Invoice is one org's bill for one billing period: per-service meter
lines, the plan fee, and late usage from earlier periods. Finalization
freezes it; a correction is a credit note, never an edit.

amount_paid.description: What has been paid, confirmed by provider readback or authorized settlement.

completeness.description:
The share of the period's usage that had reached Billing when the
invoice was finalized, from 0 to 1; below 1 the invoice carries a note.

credit_notes.description: Credit notes issued against this invoice, oldest first.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/invoices/{invoice}`.

number.description: The human-readable invoice number, unique per org.

paid_time.description: When the invoice was paid in full.

period_end_time.description: The end of the billed period.

period_start_time.description: The start of the billed period.

settlements.description: Immutable authorized external payment records, oldest first.

subtotal.description: The sum of the rounded lines before tax.

sylphx.billing.v1.InvoiceLine.description: InvoiceLine is one line of an invoice.

amount.description:
The line amount in minor units. Project usage lines share the half-even
rounded org price total; deterministic residual allocation conserves it.

meter.description: The meter id, for usage lines.

meter_version.description: The meter version, for usage lines.

project.description:
The project whose usage this line rates. Empty for org-level lines and
historical invoices without recorded project attribution. Included
allowances are pooled per org and price, never duplicated per project.

quantity.description: The rated quantity, in the meter's base unit.

service.description: The service the line belongs to; empty for the plan fee.

shadow_cost.description:
Sylphx's internal cost to serve, never billed. Returned only on GET/List
to an authenticated org-wide platform seller operator holding billing:read
and billing:operator:read; absent from customer and recordPayment responses.
Unset without a recorded shadow price. Project costs conserve rounded org
COGS per price by the same deterministic allocation.

sylphx.billing.v1.InvoiceLineKind.description: InvoiceLineKind is what an invoice line charges for.

sylphx.billing.v1.InvoiceSettlement.description:
InvoiceSettlement is an immutable full payment recorded by a seller operator
with platform-only billing:payments:record. Internal settlement is noncash.

amount.description: The exact full outstanding amount settled.

payment_id.description: Deterministic identity of the recorded payment.

recorder.description: Principal from the verified seller Access grant, never supplied by the request.

settlement_reference.description: External provider, bank or internal journal reference.

sylphx.billing.v1.InvoiceState.description: InvoiceState is the lifecycle state of an Invoice.

sylphx.billing.v1.Meter.description:
A Meter is one billable quantity a service emits, for example
`hosting.vcpu_seconds`. Meters are top-level and
read-only; each has immutable versions, and a usage event names the
version it was measured under.

current_version.description: The version new usage is measured under.

name.description:
`meters/{meter}`, where `{meter}` is the meter id
`{service}.{quantity}`, for example `meters/hosting.vcpu_seconds`.

service.description: The service that emits the meter; the meter id's prefix.

sylphx.billing.v1.MeterAggregation.description: MeterAggregation is how a meter's quantities combine over a period.

sylphx.billing.v1.MeterDimension.description: MeterDimension is one key a usage event of a meter may carry.

values.description: The allowed values; empty means a bounded free-form string.

sylphx.billing.v1.MeterPrice.description:
MeterPrice is a plan's included quantity and price for one meter version,
optionally narrowed to a dimension set (metering.md §4.3).

dimension_match.description:
The dimensions a usage row must carry for this price to apply; the most
specific match wins.

included.description: The quantity included per period, in the meter's base unit.

meter_version.description: The meter version the price applies to.

overage.description: What happens past the included quantity.

tiers.description: Price tiers past the included quantity, lowest first.

sylphx.billing.v1.MeterVersion.description: MeterVersion is one immutable definition of a meter.

aggregation.description: How quantities combine over a period.

dimensions.description: The dimensions a usage event may carry; at most 8.

effective_time.description: When usage starts being measured under this version.

hard_spend.description: Spend is bounded by budget leases.

unit.description: The base unit, for example `s`, `B`, or `tokens`.

value_scale.description:
A quantity is an integer count of 1/value_scale base units; 1 for
integral units.

sylphx.billing.v1.Money.description: Money is an amount in one currency, in integer minor units.

units_minor.description: The amount in the currency's minor unit (cents for USD).

sylphx.billing.v1.Overage.description: Overage is what happens when usage passes a plan's included quantity.

sylphx.billing.v1.Plan.description:
A Plan is a public or private price list: Free, Pro, and the private
plans onboarding needs (`agent-trial`, partner plans). Plans are top-level
and read-only; each has immutable dated versions, and an org is on
exactly one plan version at a time.

current_version.description: The version new subscriptions start on, for example `2026-11-02`.

listed.description:
Listed on the pricing page; private plans are visible only to their
orgs.

name.description: `plans/{plan}`, for example `plans/pro`.

sylphx.billing.v1.PlanVersion.description: PlanVersion is one immutable, dated version of a plan.

fee.description: The monthly fee, charged in advance.

included_credit.description: A monthly usage credit applied to overage.

meter_prices.description: Included quantity and price per meter.

payment_method_required.description: A payment method is required to be on this plan.

rate_limit_policies.description:
The rate limit per rate class (`control`, `inference`) as a token bucket,
then the higher limits of each committed-spend band.

rate_limits.description:
Requests per minute per rate class (`rate_limit_policies` × 60, without
bursts or bands).

resource_limits.description:
The most Resources per collection, for example `projects`; -1 means
unlimited.

version.description: The version, the date it takes effect: `YYYY-MM-DD`.

sylphx.billing.v1.PriceTier.description: PriceTier is one tier of a graduated price.

unit_amount_minor.description: The price per base unit, in minor units of the plan's currency.

upper_bound.description:
The tier ends at this quantity in the period, inclusive; 0 means
unbounded.

end_time.description: The end of the range, exclusive; at most 400 days after `start_time`.

group_dimensions.description: Dimension keys to group by, for example `model`.

group_projects.description: Group by project in addition to meter.

meters.description: Only these meter ids; empty means every meter.

projects.description: Only these projects; empty means every project.

start_time.description: The start of the range, inclusive.

completeness.description: The share of the range's usage that has reached Billing, from 0 to 1.

rows.description: One row per bucket and group, in time order; at most 10,000.

watermarks.description:
Each emitting service's watermark: the time of the oldest usage it has
not yet delivered.

sylphx.billing.v1.RateLimitPolicy.description: RateLimitPolicy is one rate class's token bucket on a plan version.

burst.description: Requests the bucket holds for a burst.

min_monthly_spend.description: Set on a band: the committed monthly spend from which it applies.

requests_per_second.description: Sustained requests per second, per org.

sylphx.billing.v1.Rational.description:

rounds once, at the invoice line.

sylphx.billing.v1.UsageLine.description: UsageLine is the usage of one project, meter, and dimension set.

The rated amount so far, before rounding to the invoice line; unset
while the meter has no price for these dimensions.

sylphx.billing.v1.UsageReport.description:

per project, meter, and dimensions, with how complete it is. The id is the
period, for example `orgs/{org}/usage_reports/2026-11`.

The share of the period's usage that has reached Billing, from 0 to 1,
from every emitter's watermark.

invoice.description: The period's invoice, once one exists.

watermarks.description:
Each emitting service's watermark: the time of the oldest usage it has
not yet delivered.

sylphx.billing.v1.UsageRow.description: UsageRow is one bucket of a usage query.

sylphx.build.v1.Build.description:
A Build runs one command or builds one image over one input. The input is
a commit (read through the Broker at that exact commit) or a tree uploaded
to the org's store; the output is the command's exit code and named
artifacts, or an image with an SBOM and signed provenance. A Build is
immutable once created; it ends with its output or a typed failure.

sylphx.build.v1.BuildCache.description:
A BuildCache is a per-project cache. It makes builds faster and never
changes their result; a missing or unreachable cache only slows a build.

sylphx.common.v1.Condition.description:
Condition is one observation a controller makes about a Resource
(kstatus: `Ready`, `Reconciling`, `Stalled`). A Resource is settled when
`status.observed_generation == meta.generation` and `Reconciling` is not
TRUE; it is healthy when settled and `Ready` is TRUE.

observed_generation.description: The generation this observation was made against.

reason.description: A machine-readable UpperCamelCase reason.

severity.description: How severe a FALSE condition is.

sylphx.common.v1.ConditionStatus.description: ConditionStatus is the truth value of a Condition.

sylphx.common.v1.EntitlementDenial.description:
EntitlementDenial is the detail of `PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED` and
`SPEND_LIMIT_REACHED` (metering.md §9.3).

limit.description: The limit in the meter's unit.

meter.description: The meter that hit its limit.

upgrade_url.description: Where the org can raise the limit.

sylphx.common.v1.ErrorCode.description:
ErrorCode is the registry of error codes (§6.3 rule 5). A method lists the
codes it may return in `(sylphx.common.v1.method).errors`, without the
`ERROR_CODE_` prefix. Adding a code is additive; removing one is breaking.

sylphx.common.v1.ErrorEffect.description:
ErrorEffect says what a failed call committed (standards/dx.md "retry and
effect status").

sylphx.common.v1.Operation.description:
Operation is the wire shape of a long-running operation
(resource-api-and-clients.md §3.9, AIP-151).

In the schema, a long-running method returns `google.longrunning.Operation`
with `google.longrunning.operation_info`, so the AIP linter can check it;
on the wire, and in every generated client, that return type is this
message. An Operation of a reconciled Resource is a view, not a second
state machine: it is `done` when the target's `observed_generation` reaches
`target_generation` and `Reconciling` is not TRUE.

custom_verb.description: The custom method verb when `verb` is CUSTOM, for example `revoke`.

error.description: The failure, as the one error body.

name.description: `{parent-of-target}/operations/{operation}`.

response.description: The settled Resource (or Empty for a delete).

target.description: The name of the Resource being changed.

target_generation.description: The generation this Operation waits for.

sylphx.common.v1.OperationProgress.description:
OperationProgress is the progress of an Operation that is not done. It is
also the `metadata_type` of every long-running method.

conditions.description: The target's conditions when this progress was read.

percent.description: Percent complete, when the controller can tell.

sylphx.common.v1.OperationVerb.description: OperationVerb is the kind of change an Operation carries.

current_etag.description: The Resource's current etag, so the client can re-read and retry.

sylphx.common.v1.ProblemDetails.description:
ProblemDetails is the one error body of every method and service
(resource-api-and-clients.md §3.8): RFC 9457 problem details served as
`application/problem+json`.

code.description: The stable UPPER_SNAKE code, one of ErrorCode without its prefix.

detail.description:
A customer-safe explanation of this occurrence. Never contains SQL, stack
traces, internal hostnames, or another tenant's data.

details.description: Typed details such as PreconditionFailure or EntitlementDenial.

grpc_status.description: One of the 16 canonical gRPC status names, for example `ABORTED`.

retry_after_ms.description: How long to wait before retrying, when the server knows.

retryable.description: Whether the same request may be retried.

title.description: A short customer-safe summary of the problem class.

sylphx.common.v1.ResourceMeta.description: ResourceMeta is the metadata every Resource carries in field 3.

creator.description: The principal that created the Resource.

delete_time.description: Set while the Resource is being deleted.

etag.description:
Strong ETag (AIP-154): changes on any change to spec, status, or
metadata. Send it back as `If-Match` or `etag` to make Update and Delete
conditional; a mismatch fails with ABORTED / 409 `ETAG_MISMATCH`.

sylphx.common.v1.Severity.description: Severity grades a Condition that does not hold.

sylphx.config.v1.ConditionOperator.description:

The response of SnapshotConfigFlags: an environment's whole ruleset, what
a local evaluator needs, at one version.

sylphx.config.v1.TargetingCondition.description:
TargetingCondition compares one attribute of the evaluation context with a
value. The public contract is structured rather than an expression
language (CEL): every SDK evaluates rules locally, and a small table of
operators is the same in Rust, TypeScript and any later SDK without an
expression runtime in each; a write is checked field by field against the
schema; a console and an agent edit fields, not source text; and
evaluation cost is bounded by the rule's size, with no program to run.
The operators are the ones customers already used.

attribute.description:
`user_id`, `anonymous_id`, or a path into the context's `attributes`,
dot-separated (`plan`, `device.os`). Required, except with IN_SEGMENT and
NOT_IN_SEGMENT.

value.description:
The value compared with; a list for IN and NOT_IN, a string for the
string, regular expression and semantic version operators.

sylphx.config.v1.TargetingRule.description:
TargetingRule serves a value to evaluations that match its conditions, to
a stable percentage of them.

Percentages use one bucket per flag and evaluation subject: bucket =
FNV-1a 32-bit of the UTF-8 string `{config_flag}:{subject}`, mod 100,
where `{config_flag}` is the flag's id and `{subject}` the value of
`bucket_attribute`. A rule matches when bucket < percentage. The bucket
does not depend on the rule, so rules on the same attribute split
cumulatively: 30/30/40 across three values is three rules at 30, 60 and
100, and a subject keeps its bucket when the percentage grows.

bucket_attribute.description:
The context attribute hashed for the bucket: `user_id`, `anonymous_id`,
or an attribute path; default `user_id`, else `anonymous_id`. An
evaluation without it never matches a rule below 100 percent.

conditions.description:
Conditions over the evaluation context; all must hold. None matches
every evaluation.

percentage.description:
Serve `value` to evaluations whose bucket is below this, from 0 to 100;
default 100. The rest fall through to the next rule.

sylphx.events.v1.InboundEndpoint.description:
An Inbound Endpoint receives a provider's webhooks. Events verifies the
provider signature with a secret in Sylphx Secrets, dedupes by the
provider's delivery id, answers 2xx inside the provider's budget, persists
the raw request, then publishes it onto a Topic. A bad signature is refused
and recorded.

sylphx.events.v1.Queue.description:
A Queue holds messages for pull consumers. A consumer leases messages for a
visibility timeout, then acks or nacks them; a lease is fenced, so a stale
holder cannot ack a message someone else holds. A message leased
`max_deliveries` times moves to the dead-letter queue.

retention.description: How long an unacked message is kept; default 4d, at most 14d.

visibility_timeout.description: How long a lease hides a message; default 30s, 1s to 12h.

sylphx.events.v1.RealtimeChannel.description:
A Realtime Channel delivers matching events to authorized clients over
WebSocket or SSE, resumable from a cursor. Subscriptions route events into
it; Notify's inbox rides it.

Endpoint, or Realtime Channel: exactly one message per (subscription,
event).

A Topic is a named stream producers publish CloudEvents into. An event is
immutable and deduplicated by `source` + `id` within the Topic; a different
payload under the same pair is a conflict, never a second fact.

sylphx.events.v1.WebhookDelivery.description:
A Webhook Delivery is one event on its way to a Webhook Endpoint, with every
attempt and its immutable receipt. A receipt is evidence of an endpoint
response, never of a human reading.

event_type.description: The CloudEvents `type` of the event delivered.
