sylphx.events.v1.WebhookEndpoint.description:
A Webhook Endpoint is an HTTPS receiver that events of its environment
whose type matches `spec.event_types` are delivered to, signed per Standard
Webhooks (`webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature`). Failures
retry on the fixed schedule (immediately, 5s, 5m, 30m, 2h, 5h, 10h, 10h);
exhausted deliveries dead-letter; an endpoint whose attempts keep failing
for five days is disabled.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/webhook_endpoints/{webhook_endpoint}`.

event_types.description:
Which event types the endpoint receives: an exact type (`order.paid`), a
prefix ending in `.*` (`order.*`), or `*` for every type; default `["*"]`.

max_concurrent_deliveries.description: At most this many deliveries in flight; default 10.

rate_limit_per_second.description:
At most this many attempts start per second; 0 is no limit. Deliveries
over the limit wait their turn; none is dropped.

uri.description:
The HTTPS URI deliveries are POSTed to; its host resolves to a public
address.

The Standard Webhooks signing secret (`whsec_…`). Set only in the answer
of CreateWebhookEndpoint and RotateWebhookEndpointSecret; every other
read leaves it empty, and Events never shows it again.

A Rollout moves one Service generation to its Release in waves (one canary
cell, one cell, one region, all); every step is fenced by the Service
generation at the moment of write, and no wave advances without fresh
recorded evidence.

in waves, serves on its routes, and idles to zero when unused.

A Key is a non-exportable key on the regional signer: a handle for
signing, encryption, or MAC. Rotation adds a version and keeps the old
one usable for verification and decryption until it is destroyed.

A ContextPack is what recall found: entities, facts with their time, and

sylphx.knowledge.v1.Entity.description:
An Entity is a thing with identity: a typed node with a title, aliases,
properties and external ids. Its identity is one per graph (the
environment), so one person is one entity across every space; it is
visible to a reader who may read its home space or at least one of its
facts.

aliases.description: Other names it is known by; at most 50.

create_time.description: When the entity was first recorded.

entity_type.description:
The type: a core type (`person`, `organisation`, `customer`, `contact`,
`product`, `project`, `document`, `decision`, `playbook`, `case`,
`topic`) or a type of an accepted Knowledge Schema, `<schema>.<type>`.

external_ids.description:
Identifiers in other systems. Two writes with the same external id in
one graph are the same entity (deterministic resolution). At most 50.

lifecycle.description: Whether the entity stands on its own or was merged into another.

merged_entities.description: The entities merged into this one; each can be split back out.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/entities/{entity}`.

properties.description: Properties, valid against the type's JSON Schema.

provenance.description: Where it came from and who wrote it.

space.description: The space the entity was first stated in.

survivor.description:
The entity this one was merged into, while `lifecycle` is
`ENTITY_LIFECYCLE_MERGED`.

title.description: The name people use for it.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.EntityLifecycle.description: EntityLifecycle is whether an entity stands on its own.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.EntityTypeDefinition.description: An EntityTypeDefinition is one entity type of a schema.

description.description:
What the type is, for people and for extraction; at most 1000
characters.

match_kinds.description:
The external id kinds that resolve entities of this type
deterministically, for example `email` and `phone` for a contact.

properties_schema.description: The JSON Schema (2020-12) an entity's `properties` must satisfy.

type_id.description:
The type id within the schema, snake_case; entities name it
`<schema>.<type>`.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.Episode.description:
An Episode is the source of everything in the graph: one write as it
happened (a note, a message, a step result, a document chunk, an imported
row), with its provenance. Creating one is `remember`; extraction reads it
afterwards and proposes entities and relations that cite it.

data.description:
Structured content, for a caller that already knows the shape (an
imported row, a form).

entities.description:
The entities the caller says the episode is about, as resource names;
extraction adds the ones it finds. At most 50.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/spaces/{space}/episodes/{episode}`.

occur_time.description: When it happened in the world; default the time it was recorded.

provenance.description: Where it came from and who wrote it.

text.description:
The text as written, at most 64 KiB. An episode has `text`, `data`, or
both.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.EpisodeKind.description: EpisodeKind is what an episode is.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.ExternalId.description: An ExternalId is an entity's identifier in another system.

kind.description:
The kind of identifier: `email`, `phone`, `auth_subject`,
`channel_user`, `account`, or a caller's own kind.

value.description: The identifier, normalised (a lowercase email, an E.164 phone number).

sylphx.knowledge.v1.Extraction.description: Extraction is where reading an episode for entities and relations stands.

name.description: The name of the entity to get.
The name of the episode to get.
The name of the knowledge_schema to get.
The name of the relation to get.
The name of the space to get.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.KnowledgeSchema.description:
A Knowledge Schema is a published, versioned set of types a graph accepts:
entity types with a JSON Schema each, and relation types. A type pack (the
customer pack) is a schema, not code. The core schema is built in.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/knowledge_schemas/{knowledge_schema}`.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.KnowledgeSchemaSpec.description: KnowledgeSchemaSpec is the caller-writable state of a Knowledge Schema.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.KnowledgeSchemaStatu.description: KnowledgeSchemaStatus is the observed state of a Knowledge Schema.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

revision.description:
The published revision; each accepted update adds one. A record keeps
the revision it was validated against.

Why they are the same, recorded with the merge; at most 1000

related_entities.description: The other entities those facts name.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.Provenance.description:
Provenance says where a record came from and who wrote it. A record with
no source is refused.

actor.description:
The caller that made the write when it is not the principal: an agent
(`agent:<id>`), an app key (`api_key:<id>`) or a connector.

confidence.description: For an extracted record, the extractor's confidence, 0 to 1.

method.description:
How the content was produced; default `SOURCE_METHOD_STATED`. Only the
service writes `SOURCE_METHOD_EXTRACTED`.

model.description: For an extracted record, the model id that extracted it.

principal.description:
The principal the write is attributed to, as a share subject
(`user:<id>`, `end_user:<id>`): the member or end user an agent or app
acts for. Set by the server from the caller's credential.

references.description:
References to where the content came from: a run and step, a work item,
a message, a URL. At most 20.

entity_types.description: Only entities of these types; default every type.

max_facts.description: At most this many facts in the pack; default 30, clamped to 200.

max_hops.description: How many hops to expand from the top entities, 0 to 2; default 2.

parent.description: The environment whose graph to search.

query.description: What to recall, in natural language; 1 to 4000 characters.

spaces.description:
The spaces to search, as resource names; default every space the caller
may read. At most 50.

valid_time.description: Recall the graph as it was valid at this time; default now.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.Relation.description:
A Relation is a fact: a typed, directed edge between two entities, or a
value about one entity. Facts are bi-temporal: `valid_start_time` and
`valid_end_time` say when it holds in the world, `create_time` and
`supersede_time` when it was learned and replaced. A change closes the old
fact; nothing is overwritten. Every fact cites at least one episode.

episodes.description:
The episodes the fact comes from. A structured write with none records
its own episode and cites it; an extracted fact cites the episodes it was
read from.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/spaces/{space}/relations/{relation}`.

object.description: The other entity, for an edge. A fact has `object`, `value`, or both.

predicate.description:
The relation type, snake_case, for example `works_at` or `prefers`; a
core predicate or one of an accepted Knowledge Schema.

provenance.description: Where it came from and who wrote it.

statement.description: The fact as one sentence, used for search and shown with citations.

subject.description: The entity the fact is about.

successor.description: The fact that replaced this one, once it is superseded.

supersede_time.description: When the fact was replaced by a newer record; unset while current.

valid_end_time.description: When the fact stopped holding in the world; unset while it holds.

valid_start_time.description: When the fact starts to hold in the world; default when it was recorded.

value.description: The value, for a fact about one entity.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.RelationTypeDefiniti.description: A RelationTypeDefinition is one relation type of a schema.

description.description: What the relation means; at most 1000 characters.

object_types.description: The entity types the object may have; empty is a value fact or any.

predicate.description:
The predicate within the schema, snake_case; relations name it
`<schema>.<predicate>`.

subject_types.description: The entity types the subject may have; empty is any.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.SourceMethod.description: SourceMethod is how a record's content was produced.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.SourceRef.description: A SourceRef points at where a record's content came from.

label.description: A short label to show with a citation.

uri.description: A URI: a URL, or a URN of a platform record such as a Workflows run step.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.Space.description:
A Space is the permission container of the graph: a workspace, a project, a
team, one end user's private space, one agent's private space. Every
Episode and Relation lives in exactly one space, and a principal sees a
record only through a space it may read. Read and write are the share
relations `reader`, `writer` and `owner` on the space, inherited through
`parent`.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/spaces/{space}`.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.SpaceGrant.description: A SpaceGrant is one share tuple on a space: `space:<id>#<role>@<subject>`.

subject.description:
The share subject: `user:<id>`, `end_user:<id>`, `agent:<id>`, or a
userset such as `workspace:<id>#member`.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.SpaceKind.description: SpaceKind is what a space holds.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.SpaceRole.description: SpaceRole is a share relation on a space.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.SpaceSpec.description: SpaceSpec is the caller-writable state of a Space.

grants.description:
Who may read and write the space, beyond `owner` and what `parent`
grants; at most 200. A repeated grant is stored once.

owner.description:
The principal a private space belongs to, as a share subject:
`end_user:<id>` for `SPACE_KIND_END_USER`, `agent:<id>` or
`agent:<id>/end_user:<id>` for `SPACE_KIND_AGENT`. Empty for a shared
space. The owner is granted `owner` on the space.

parent.description:
The space this one inherits grants from, for example a project space
under its workspace space. A reader of the parent reads this space.

schemas.description:
The Knowledge Schemas whose types the space accepts, as resource names;
the core schema is always accepted. At most 20.

sensitive.description:
The space holds customer personal data. Its records are never sent in
embeddings outside the cell's model routes, and enter a context pack or
an answer that spans spaces only for a reader that holds `reader` on
this space directly. Only deterministic entity matches apply to it.

sylphx.knowledge.v1.SpaceStatus.description: SpaceStatus is the observed state of a Space.

episode_count.description: The number of episodes in the space.

fact_count.description: The number of current facts in the space.

last_write_time.description: When a record of the space was last written.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

name.description: The entity a merge folded the other into.

survivor.description: The entity that was merged into, after the split.

Create the entity when no entity matches (`upsert_entity`): the name, or
else `external_ids`, identifies it.

sylphx.localization.v1.Catalog.description:
A Catalog is a string catalog: one source locale, its target locales, and
how to translate them. Its entries are written by `:sync`; `:export` returns
the files per locale.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/catalogs/{catalog}`.

sylphx.localization.v1.CatalogEntry.description:
A Catalog Entry is one source message and its translations. `:sync` writes
it; it is never created directly. Its id is a stable hash of the file and
key, assigned by the server.

context.description: Disambiguates the same text with different meanings.

create_time.description: When the entry was first synced.

file.description:
The source file's path within the upload; empty for a single-file
catalog.

key.description:
The source text plus an optional `|context`, or an id for id-keyed
formats.

max_length.description: The longest a translation may be, in characters; 0 is no limit.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/catalogs/{catalog}/entries/{entry}`.

source_hash.description:
The first 16 lowercase hex characters of the SHA-256 of the UTF-8 source
pattern. A translation is stale when its source hash differs.

source_text.description: The source message, a Unicode MessageFormat 2 pattern.

state.description: Whether the source still has this message.

translations.description: The translations, one per target locale at most.

sylphx.localization.v1.CatalogFile.description: A CatalogFile is one file of a catalog.

content.description: The file's text, UTF-8; at most 4 MiB.

locale.description: The file's locale, a BCP 47 tag.

path.description:
The file's path. The service does not interpret it and echoes it back, for
example a namespace file name.

sylphx.localization.v1.CatalogSpec.description: CatalogSpec is the caller-writable state of a Catalog.

glossaries.description: The glossaries this catalog applies, as Glossary names; at most 10.

locale_guidance.description:
Extra instructions per target locale, for example the vocabulary of a
region. Keys are target locales; at most 60 entries, each at most 2000
characters.

pseudo_locales.description:
Pseudo-locales to generate at export. They are never stored or
translated.

source_locale.description: The locale the source texts are written in, a BCP 47 tag such as `en`.

target_locales.description:
The locales to translate into, BCP 47 tags. `zh-Hant-HK` and `zh-Hant-TW`
are separate locales. At most 60, each once.

tone.description: The brand voice every translation follows, at most 2000 characters.

sylphx.localization.v1.CatalogStatus.description: CatalogStatus is the observed state of a Catalog.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

catalog.description: The catalog to create; only caller-writable fields are read.

catalog_id.description:
The catalog id, the final name segment; the server assigns one when
empty.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

glossary.description: The glossary to create; only caller-writable fields are read.

glossary_id.description:
The glossary id, the final name segment; the server assigns one when
empty.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

allow_missing.description: Succeed when the catalog does not exist.

etag.description: Delete only if the current etag matches.

force.description:
Also delete the catalog's entries; without it, a catalog that has entries
is refused with `INVALID_STATE`.

name.description: The name of the catalog to delete.

validate_only.description: Validate without deleting anything.

allow_missing.description: Succeed when the glossary does not exist.

etag.description: Delete only if the current etag matches.

name.description: The name of the glossary to delete.

validate_only.description: Validate without deleting anything.

sylphx.localization.v1.EntryState.description: EntryState is whether a Catalog Entry is still in the source.

locales.description: The locales to export; default every target locale and the pseudo-locales.

name.description: The name of the catalog.

source_fallback.description:
Emit the source text for keys that have no passing translation, for
runtimes that do not fall back to the source themselves.

files.description: One file per source file per locale, with the source file's `path`.

glyph_sets.description: The characters each locale's texts use.

report.description: The QA report. A translation with an error is never exported.

sylphx.localization.v1.Format.description:
A file format the catalog is read from and written to. The canonical
catalog is `FORMAT_SYLPHX_JSON`; every other format is an adapter, never a
second store.

name.description: The name of the catalog entry to get.
The name of the catalog to get.
The name of the glossary to get.

sylphx.localization.v1.Glossary.description:
A Glossary is the terms shared by the catalogs that name it, one per brand
or product family.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/glossaries/{glossary}`.

sylphx.localization.v1.GlossarySpec.description: GlossarySpec is the caller-writable state of a Glossary.

sylphx.localization.v1.GlossaryStatus.description: GlossaryStatus is the observed state of a Glossary.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

sylphx.localization.v1.GlossaryTerm.description: A GlossaryTerm is one term and the rule for it.

case_sensitive.description: Match the term's letter case exactly.

description.description: A note for translators, at most 500 characters.

locales.description: The locales the term applies to; empty is every locale.

rule.description: What to do with the term.

term.description: The term, as written in the source.

translations.description: Locale to the required translation; used by `TERM_RULE_TRANSLATE`.

sylphx.localization.v1.GlyphSet.description: A GlyphSet is the characters one locale uses, for font atlases.

characters.description: Every distinct character the locale's texts use, sorted.

filter.description:
AIP-160 filter, limited to `state`, `locale`, and `qa_state`; for example
`state = ENTRY_STATE_ACTIVE AND locale = "ja" AND qa_state = QA_STATE_FAILED`.

sylphx.localization.v1.LocaleProgress.description: LocaleProgress counts the active entries of one target locale by state.

failed.description: Entries whose translation still fails QA after repair.

translated.description: Entries with a translation that passed QA.

name.description: The name of the catalog entry.

text.description: The translated message, a Unicode MessageFormat 2 pattern.

sylphx.localization.v1.PseudoLocale.description: A pseudo-locale is a synthetic locale generated at export to test layout.

sylphx.localization.v1.QaFinding.description: A QaFinding is one problem QA found in a translation.

sylphx.localization.v1.QaReport.description: A QaReport is the QA result of an export.

sylphx.localization.v1.QaSeverity.description: QaSeverity is how serious a QA finding is.

sylphx.localization.v1.QaState.description: QaState is the QA result of a translation.

translations.description:
The committed target-locale files; at most 10000. A text that differs from
the service's last export is recorded as a pinned human override.

validate_only.description: Validate the files and return the counts without writing or translating.

adopted.description: Existing translations taken from the committed files.

failed.description: Translations still failing QA after repair.

obsoleted.description: Entries no longer in the source.

pending.description: Translations still to make; call again until it is 0.

pinned.description: Committed edits recorded as human overrides.

sylphx.localization.v1.TermRule.description: TermRule is what a glossary term requires.

sylphx.localization.v1.Translation.description: A Translation is the text of one entry in one target locale.

qa_state.description: The result of QA on the text.

stale.description: The source changed since this text was made.

sylphx.localization.v1.TranslationOrigin.description: TranslationOrigin is where a translation's text came from.

sylphx.localization.v1.Usage.description: Usage is what one call consumed.

memory_matches.description: Translations reused from the translation memory, which are free.

translated_characters.description:
Source characters translated by this call, per target locale; the billed
quantity.

sylphx.money.v1.AppStoreConnection.description: AppStoreConnection is an App Store Server API key and the app's bundle ids.

account_token_prefix.description:
An earlier `appAccountToken` scheme the app's shipped builds use: the
token is UUIDv5 in the URL namespace of this prefix followed by the
subject id (for example `https://accounts.example.com/v2/`). Tokens in
Money's own scheme are always accepted as well.

app_apple_id.description: The app's Apple id: when set, production notifications must carry it.

environment.description:
The store environment this connection serves: `production` or `sandbox`.
Only purchases signed for that environment are accepted (plus sandbox
ones on a production connection with `allow_sandbox`), and each is read
back from its own environment's App Store Server API. Xcode and
local-testing signatures are refused either way. A connection created
before this field existed serves `production`.

issuer_id.description: The App Store Connect issuer id.

private_key.description:
The In-App Purchase key (`.p8` PEM). Write-only: sealed on write, never
returned; omit it on update to keep the stored key.

results.description: One per event, in request order.

at_period_end.description: End it at the period end (true) or now (false).

name.description: The subscription to cancel.

refund_last_payment.description: Refund the last payment in full; only with `at_period_end` false.

sylphx.money.v1.Catalog.description:
A Catalog is an environment's features, products, and prices: the desired
state Money keeps its merchant account's processor objects equal to, by
lookup key. It is declared in `sylphx.toml` `[money]` or written here.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/price_catalogs/default`.

sylphx.money.v1.CatalogSpec.description: CatalogSpec is the caller-writable state of a Catalog.

client_grant_ttl.description:
How long a signed store-purchase grant is valid, from the moment it is
issued; a client re-verifies to renew it. Default 7 days, 1 hour to 30
days.

refund_claw_back.description:
Whether a delivered one-time purchase whose money the store or processor
takes back (a refund, a void, a chargeback) gives back its goods: its
entitlements end, and the refund event asks the app to take back the
assets it granted, up to what the subject still holds. Applies once the
project is enabled for take-backs, to refunds dated from then on; unset
then means on.

sylphx.money.v1.CatalogStatus.description: CatalogStatus is the observed state of a Catalog.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

processor_price_ids.description: The processor object behind each price, by lookup key.

sync_time.description: When the processor last matched the spec.

name.description: The subscription to change.

price.description:
The key of the product's recurring price (for example monthly or yearly).
Optional when the product has one recurring price.

product.description: The key of the catalog product to move to.

proration_behavior.description: How the change is billed; unspecified is `create_prorations`.

validate_only.description:
Run every check and answer the subscription as it would read, without
changing anything.

entitled.description: Whether the subject holds the feature now.

entitlement_grant.description: The grant that answers, when entitled.

expire_time.description:
When the answering grant ends; unset for no end. A caller may cache the
answer until then.

limit.description: For a `limit` feature, the largest allowance the subject holds.

source.description:
The answering grant's source, for example `<checkout session>/line_items/<n>`:
the `grant` claim of an offline licence token.

actor_proof.description: For a customer organization: the acting user's token.

subject_proof.description: As on UsageReservation: a verified token for the subject.

sylphx.money.v1.CheckoutPolicy.description:
A Checkout Policy is an environment's seller setting for which buyers
consumer checkout refuses, by buyer country (docs/services/money/web-payments.md,
"Denying consumer checkout by country"). One per environment, id `default`;
an environment without one refuses nobody.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/checkout_policies/default`.

sylphx.money.v1.CheckoutPolicySpec.description: CheckoutPolicySpec is the caller-writable state of a CheckoutPolicy.

allow_tax_id_buyers.description:
Whether a buyer from a denied country who gives a tax id (a business)
may still buy. Checkout then asks for the tax id; default false.

denied_country_codes.description:
Buyer countries consumer checkout refuses: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes
(`DE`), or the group `EU` (the 27 member states). At most 300 entries.
Empty refuses nobody.

sylphx.money.v1.CheckoutSession.description:
A Checkout Session is a hosted page where a subject pays for catalog
prices. Money creates the processor's session on the environment's
merchant account and returns its URL.

allow_promotion_codes.description: Whether the buyer may enter a promotion code.

billing_country_code.description:
The billing country the completed checkout was checked against, upper-case
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; empty until completion.

billing_subdivision_code.description:
The billing state or province, upper-case, kept only for the countries
whose tax thresholds are per subdivision (`US`, `CA`); empty otherwise.
Nothing else of the buyer's address is stored.

buyer_country_code.description:
Where the buyer is, upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, when the caller knows
it (for example from the request's IP address). A country the
environment's checkout policy denies is refused here, before any page is
made, unless the policy lets a business buy. Not trusted for anything
else: the billing address the buyer gives is checked again when the
payment completes.

cancel_url.description: Where the buyer lands on cancel. HTTPS only.

currency_code.description:
The currency to charge in, upper-case ISO 4217; default the processor's
choice for the buyer among the prices' currencies.

denied_reason.description:
Why a completed checkout was refused and refunded instead of delivered:
`country_denied` (the billing country is on the checkout policy's list) or
`country_unknown` (no billing country to check). Empty otherwise.

expire_time.description: When the page stops accepting payment.

line_items.description:
What is bought: catalog prices by lookup key. One recurring price makes a
subscription; one-time prices make an order.

locale.description: The page language, for example `en` or `zh-HK`; default automatic.

metadata.description:
Copied to the subscription or order, for example attribution
(`utm_source`, `ref`). At most 20 keys.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/checkout_sessions/{checkout_session}`.

success_url.description:
Where the buyer lands after paying; `{CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}` is replaced
by the processor's session id. HTTPS only.

account_token.description:
The account token the app set at purchase (Play `obfuscatedAccountId`,
App Store `appAccountToken`). A consistency check only: it must match
the subject's derivation and the store's copy.

package_name.description: Google Play: the package name, when the connection covers several.

parent.description: The environment the purchase is verified in.

product_id.description: Google Play: the store product id (for a subscription, its id).

signed_transaction.description: App Store: the StoreKit 2 signed transaction (`jwsRepresentation`).

subject.description: Who bought it: `end_user` of `inst_` and a lower-case UUID.

parent.description: The environment whose seller this becomes.

restricted_key.description:
A Stripe restricted key (`rk_test_…` or `rk_live_…`); when set, no OAuth
happens: the account is read and connected at once. Write-only: sealed on
write, never returned, never logged. A secret key (`sk_…`) is refused,
because a restricted key can be limited to what payments need.

return_url.description:
Where the browser returns after the processor, with `status` and, on
success, `merchant_account` in the query. HTTPS only. Required for the
OAuth connection; unused, and so optional, with `restricted_key`.

authorize_url.description:
The processor's authorisation page for an owner of the account to open;
empty when the connection completed in this call.

expire_time.description:
When the link stops working; unset when the connection completed in this
call.

merchant_account.description:
The merchant account, connected; set when the connection completed in
this call, which is every connection made with a restricted key.

checkout_session.description: The checkout to create; only caller-writable fields are read.

checkout_session_id.description: The id, the final name segment; the server assigns one when empty.

entitlement_grant.description:
The grant: `subject`, `feature`, `expire_time` (future, at most 400 days
out), `campaign`, `reason` and `approval_ref` are required.

entitlement_grant_id.description:
The grant's id, also its idempotency: `^[a-z]([a-z0-9_-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$`.
The same id with the same grant returns the stored one; the same id with
another grant is RESOURCE_ALREADY_EXISTS.

parent.description: The environment the grant is in.

portal_session.description: The portal session to create; only caller-writable fields are read.

portal_session_id.description: The id, the final name segment; the server assigns one when empty.

revenue_source_id.description:
The source's id; `^[a-z]([a-z0-9_-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$`. Empty: Money
assigns one.

validate_only.description: Validate only; write nothing.

store_connection.description: The store connection to create; only caller-writable fields are read.

store_connection_id.description: The store connection id, the final name segment.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

sylphx.money.v1.CreditGrant.description:
A Credit Grant is credit a merchant gives a subject: audited, append-only,
invoiced at full price and then offset once at invoice issue, soonest
expiry first. A change is a new grant that supersedes the old one.

collection_mode.description:
`standard` or `hold`; no default. Over the credit, a held invoice stays
due but is not collected until an explicit audited release.

expire_time.description: When it stops applying; required. Not renewing is how charging starts.

kind.description: `amount` (a total) or `monthly_cap` (up to the amount in each month).

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/credit_grants/{credit_grant}`.

reason.description: Why.

tax_treatment.description:
`undecided`, `price_reduction`, or `post_tax_settlement`; no default.
`post_tax_settlement` is refused while the merchant has automatic tax on.

sylphx.money.v1.CustomerSubscription.description:
A Customer Subscription is a subject's recurring purchase, mirrored from
the processor after Money read it back. Money writes it; a caller changes it
only through `:cancel` and `:resume`.

cancel_at_period_end.description: Whether it ends at `current_period_end_time` instead of renewing.

current_period_end_time.description: The end of the paid period.

items.description: The prices, by lookup key, and their quantities.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/customer_subscriptions/{customer_subscription}`.

status.description:
`trialing`, `active`, `past_due`, `paused`, `canceled`, `unpaid`,
`incomplete`, or `incomplete_expired`, as the processor reports it.

trial_end_time.description: The end of the trial, when there is one.

etag.description: The current etag; when set, the delete happens only if it matches.

name.description:
The source to delete, with the facts it reported. The `money` source
cannot be deleted (pause it instead).

validate_only.description: Validate only; delete nothing.

etag.description: The ETag the caller read; the delete fails if it changed.

name.description: The name of the store connection to delete.
The merchant account to disconnect.

sylphx.money.v1.EntitlementGrant.description:
An Entitlement Grant is one feature a subject holds, from one source: a
subscription, an order, a store purchase, or a manual grant. Money derives
it; a client event never writes one.

approval_ref.description:
A free-text reference to the approval, for example `CEO 2026-10-02`
(input on create, up to 200 characters).

approver.description:
The principal that created a manual grant: the verified key's principal,
never a request field.

campaign.description: A manual grant's campaign (input on create, up to 64 characters).

expire_time.description: When it ends; unset for no end.

limit.description: For a `limit` feature, the allowance as a decimal string.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/entitlement_grants/{entitlement_grant}`.

reason.description: A manual grant's reason (input on create, up to 500 characters).

source.description: The resource that grants it, for example a customer subscription's name.

sylphx.money.v1.ExchangeRate.description:
An Exchange Rate is the units of one currency per US dollar on one day,
from the ECB reference rates (ADR §3). A day the ECB did not publish
carries the previous business day's rate, named in `published_on`. The
table is the same for every org: any reader that converts uses it.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/exchange_rates/{currency}-{YYYY-MM-DD}`, lower case.

per_usd.description: Units of the currency per US dollar, as a decimal string.

publication_day.description:
The publication the rate is from: the day itself, or the business day
before a weekend or holiday.

uid.description: The rate's id, as in its name.

sylphx.money.v1.Feature.description:
A Feature is what an app checks, for example `plus` or
`exports.per_month`.

sylphx.money.v1.FeatureKind.description: FeatureKind is how a feature is granted.

licence_key_id.description:
The key's id; `^[a-z]([a-z0-9_-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$`. Empty: Money assigns
one.

parent.description: The environment the key belongs to.

name.description: The name of the catalog to get.
The name of the checkout policy to get.
The name of the checkout session to get.
The name of the credit grant to get.
The name of the customer subscription to get.
The name of the entitlement grant to get.
The name of the licence key to get.
The name of the merchant account to get.
The name of the portal session to get.
The name of the source to get.

end_day.description: The last day of a `range`, inclusive; at most 400 days after the first.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/revenue`.

period.description:
`today`, `mtd` (month to date, the default), `month` (with `month`), or
`range` (with `start_day` and `end_day`). Days are UTC.

name.description: The name of the store connection to get.
The name of the store purchase to get.
The name of the usage invoice to get.
The name of the usage meter to get.
The name of the usage reservation to get.
The name of the usage settings to get.

sylphx.money.v1.GooglePlayConnection.description: GooglePlayConnection is a Play service account and the app's package names.

notification_audience.description:
The audience Play's Pub/Sub push token must carry for real-time developer
notifications; unset refuses them.

notification_service_account.description: The service account Pub/Sub pushes as.

service_account_json.description:
The service account's JSON key. Write-only: sealed on write, never
returned; omit it on update to keep the stored key.

expected_public_key.description:
The public key shipped clients pin, raw base64url without padding. The
import is refused unless it is the public half of the imported key.

licence_key_id.description: The key's id; as on GenerateLicenceKeyRequest. Required.

parent.description: The environment the key belongs to.

private_key_pkcs8.description:
The Ed25519 private key as PKCS8 DER in standard base64. Write-only:
sealed on import, never returned.

sylphx.money.v1.IngestedUsageEvent.description: One already-incurred usage event of a batch.

event_id.description:
The emitter's id of this event, 1 to 128 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]`;
with the meter and its version, the dedupe key.

meter_version.description: The emitter's version of the meter's definition, 1 or more.

subject.description: Who used it, as attributed by the emitter.

sylphx.money.v1.IngestedUsageEventResult.description: What became of one ingested event.

reason.description:
For `rejected`: `invalid` (a field is out of range), `unpriced` (no
active meter with a price in force at `occurred_time`) or
`reservation_required` (the meter records only through a reservation);
empty otherwise.

usage_event.description: The UsageEvent that counts this usage, for `accepted` and `duplicate`.

sylphx.money.v1.LicenceKey.description:
A Licence Key is one Ed25519 signing key Money holds for an environment. The
private half is generated here (or imported once, for a key already pinned in
shipped clients), sealed with Money's seal keys, and never returned or
logged. The public half is exported keyless at
`GET /v1/money/licence_keys/{uid}`, in the raw base64url form a client pins.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/licence_keys/{licence_key}`.

uid.description:
`lkey_<cell><ulid>`; never reused. The keyless public export is addressed
by it.

sylphx.money.v1.LicenceKeySpec.description: LicenceKeySpec is the caller-writable state of a LicenceKey.

sylphx.money.v1.LicenceKeyStatus.description: LicenceKeyStatus is the observed state of a LicenceKey.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

public_key.description: The raw Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding.

state.description:
`active` signs new terms; `retired` signs only terms already frozen to it
and stays exported for verification.

sylphx.money.v1.LicencePolicy.description:
A LicencePolicy is the product-owned rule for the offline licence a paid
one-time purchase of the product carries. Written by the merchant with the
catalog (`billing:write`); it names no key material, only the LicenceKey that
signs. A licence is refused on a consumable product and on a product with a
recurring price. There is no grace period.

key.description: The id of the LicenceKey that signs new terms.

token_product.description: The `product` the token carries (what the client checks it against).

sylphx.money.v1.LicenceTerm.description:
A LicenceTerm is a length of time with explicit arithmetic: `days` add
exact 86 400 000 ms multiples to the UTC instant; `calendar_months` and
`calendar_years` add months to the UTC calendar date, keep the time of day,
and clamp a day that does not exist in the target month to the month's last
day (2028-02-29 plus one year is 2029-02-28).

sylphx.money.v1.LicenceTermUnit.description: LicenceTermUnit is the unit of a licence term.

sylphx.money.v1.LicenceToken.description:
A Licence Token is one issued offline licence, re-derived from its frozen
term: the same bytes every time. Money derives it; nothing writes one.

expire_time.description: When the token expires.

line.description: The checkout line the token is for.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/licence_tokens/{licence_token}`.

source.description:
The grant source the term was frozen for:
`<checkout session name>/line_items/<n>`.

sylphx.money.v1.LineItem.description: A Line Item is one catalog price and its quantity.

quantity.description: How many; default 1. Seats for a per-seat or family price.

filter.description: AIP-160 filter, for example `subject = "…"`.

page_size.description: At most this many; default 50, clamped to 1000.

next_page_token.description: The token of the next page; empty on the last page.

parent.description: The org reading: `orgs/{org}`. The rates are the same for every org.

exchange_rates.description: The page, newest day first, then by currency.

sylphx.money.v1.MerchantAccount.description:
A Merchant Account is the seller an environment charges as on the web: the
customer's own Stripe account, connected through Stripe Connect OAuth, or
with a restricted key when OAuth cannot be used (the platform's own
products). Sylphx stores the account id, and for a key connection the key
sealed, never in the clear and never returned. `:connect` starts the
connection; the processor's redirect completes an OAuth one.

account_id.description: The connected account id, for example `acct_1Nv…`.

automatic_tax.description:
Whether Stripe computes tax on this merchant's checkouts and usage
invoices (its own cost decision: Stripe Tax charges per transaction).
Off by default. Writable through `UpdateMerchantAccount`
(`update_mask = "automatic_tax"`). Turning it on is refused while a live
`post_tax_settlement` credit grant exists.

business_name.description: The business name the processor holds for the account.

charges_enabled.description: Whether the account can take payments now.

credential.description:
How the account is called at the processor: `connect` (the platform's
key acts for a connected account) or `restricted_key` (the account's own
key, held sealed).

default_currency_code.description: ISO 4217 default currency of the account, upper case.

livemode.description: Whether the connection is in live mode (false is test mode).

name.description:
`orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/merchant_accounts/{merchant_account}`;
the environment's seller is `default`.

payouts_enabled.description: Whether the account can be paid out.

refresh_time.description: When the processor last confirmed these fields.

region_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the account.

sylphx.money.v1.PortalSession.description:
A Portal Session is a hosted page where a subject manages its
subscriptions, payment method, and invoices.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/portal_sessions/{portal_session}`.

return_url.description: Where the portal's back link goes. HTTPS only.

url.description: The hosted page; valid for a few minutes.

sylphx.money.v1.Price.description: A Price is one way to pay for a product, named by its lookup key.

archived.description: Whether checkout may sell this price.

default_currency.description:
The processor's base currency: an upper-case ISO 4217 code that is a key of
`unit_amounts`. Unset uses the first currency in code order. Changing it
creates a new processor price under the same lookup key, because the base
currency is immutable there.

key.description:
The lookup key the app uses; `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$`, unique in the
catalog.

recurring_interval.description: Unset for a one-time price; `day`, `week`, `month`, or `year`.

trial_days.description: Free trial days for a recurring price.

unit_amounts.description:
Unit amount per ISO 4217 currency code in upper case, as a decimal string
of minor units, for example `{"USD": "499", "GBP": "399"}`. The processor's
base currency is `default_currency` when set, else the first currency in
code order.

sylphx.money.v1.Product.description: A Product is one thing sold, with its prices and the features it grants.

consumable.description:
Whether one purchase is used up (a pack of game currency) rather than
kept (an unlock or a subscription).

features.description:
Feature grants: a feature key and, for a `limit` feature, the allowance as
a decimal string; `true` for a boolean feature.

grants.description:
What one unit grants in the app's own assets, by asset code, as decimal
strings, for example `{"GEMS": "650"}`. Carried in the signed grant so the
app's server credits exactly this.

licence.description:
The offline licence a paid one-time purchase carries; refused on a
consumable product and on a product with a recurring price.

store_product_ids.description:
Store product ids that sell this product, by store (`app_store`,
`google_play`).

sylphx.money.v1.ProrationBehavior.description:
ProrationBehavior is how a subscription change is billed for the rest of
the current period.

name.description: The merchant account to read back.
The held invoice to release for collection.

reason.description: Who releases it, and why: both are kept.

name.description: The reservation to release.
The subscription to resume.
The key to retire.

sylphx.money.v1.RevenueBucket.description: One day or month of a RevenueSummary.

basis.description:
The weakest basis that counted in the bucket: `final` when every row is
a source's final statement, `estimated` or `booked` otherwise.

incomplete.description: A stale source has not reported this bucket yet.

lines.description: The bucket per source or product; empty when `split` is `none`.

start_day.description: The day, or the first day of the month.

total.description: The bucket's total in minor units of the reporting currency.

unconverted_count.description: Daily rows of this bucket with no rate yet.

sylphx.money.v1.RevenueFact.description:
A Revenue Fact is one line a source reported, in that line's own currency
(ADR §1): read for audit and export. Facts are written by Money's own
bookings and by imports, never through this API.

account_ref.description: The account the source reports for.

day.description: The source's reporting day; the first of the month for a month row.

external_key.description: The source's own identity for the line.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/revenue_facts/{revenue_fact}`.

product_ref.description: The product reference the source uses.

region_code.description: Buyer country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), where the source reports it.

settled_on.description: The day the money reached the bank; empty until the source says so.

uid.description: The fact's id: a hash of its source and external key.

sylphx.money.v1.RevenueLine.description: One source's or product's share of a total.

key.description:
The source's name (`orgs/{org}/revenue_sources/{id}`), or the product as
`{store_kind}/{product_ref}`.

label.description:
The source's display name, or the product's label; the reference itself
when the product has no label.

total.description: In minor units of the reporting currency.

sylphx.money.v1.RevenueSource.description:
A Revenue Source is one place an org's revenue is read from. `kind`
selects the connector Money implements once (ADR §2). The `money` source
is implicit, one per environment with Money, made the first time Money
books a sale there; it cannot be created or deleted through the API, only
renamed or paused. A connector's credential is sealed and never returned;
connectors arrive kind by kind, and a source of a kind whose connector has
not shipped yet is registered and reported stale until it first syncs.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/revenue_sources/{revenue_source}`.

sylphx.money.v1.RevenueSourceSpec.description: RevenueSourceSpec is the caller-writable state of a RevenueSource.

config.description:
The connector's settings (an account id, a bucket, a column mapping),
never a credential. At most 32 entries.

display_name.description: Shown on summaries and in the console.

kind.description:
`money`, `stripe`, `google_play`, `app_store`, `ad_network`, `file` or
`manual`. Set on create and never changed; `money` is never created.

paused.description: A paused source is not synced and cannot be run; its facts still count.

sylphx.money.v1.RevenueSourceStatus.description: RevenueSourceStatus is the observed state of a RevenueSource.

conditions.description:
`Ready` while the source is fresh; `False` with reason `Stale`,
`Paused` or `NeverSynced` otherwise.

environment.description:
For a `money` source, the environment it books:
`orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}`. Empty for every other kind.

last_run_error.description: The last failed run's error code; never a response body.

last_run_state.description: The last run: `running`, `succeeded` or `failed`; empty before the first.

last_success_time.description:
When the source last synced successfully. Unset for a `money` source,
which books in real time.

newest_day.description: The newest day the source holds, `YYYY-MM-DD`; empty when it holds none.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

stale.description:
The newest day is older than the kind's normal lag plus one day, or the
source has never synced: summaries name it and mark the days it has not
reported as incomplete.

sylphx.money.v1.RevenueSummary.description:
The Revenue Summary is an org's revenue over a period, read from the daily
roll-up and never from raw facts (ADR §4), converted into one reporting
currency at each day's rate (§3), with the highest basis counting for each
store, product and day (§1 "Which row counts"). Computed on every read;
nothing writes it.

buckets.description: One bucket per day or month that holds revenue, oldest first.

currency_code.description: The reporting currency every converted amount is in.

end_day.description: The last day of the period, inclusive.

incomplete.description: A stale source has not reported some day of the period.

lines.description:
The period's total per source or product, largest first; empty when
`split` is `none`.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/revenue`.

stale_sources.description: Sources that report late: their missing days make the period incomplete.

start_day.description: The first day of the period, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

total.description: The period's total, in minor units of the reporting currency.

unconverted.description:
Amounts with no exchange rate for their day yet, in their own currency:
counted here, never in `total`.

unconverted_count.description: Daily rows that had no rate and are in `unconverted`.

end_day.description: The last day of a backfill, `YYYY-MM-DD`, inclusive.

mode.description:
`sync` (default) reads what is new; `backfill` re-reads the period
`start_day` to `end_day`.

name.description: The source to run.

start_day.description: The first day of a backfill, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

state.description: `succeeded`, `failed`, or `running` while a connector works through it.

name.description: The reservation to settle.

occurred_time.description: When the work happened; now when absent.

quantity_used.description:
What was used, in the meter's base unit; 0 to the granted quantity, or
more after expiry (the work happened).

sylphx.money.v1.StaleRevenueSource.description: A source named on a summary because it reports late.

newest_day.description: The newest day it holds; empty when it holds none.

sylphx.money.v1.StoreConnection.description:
A Store Connection is the environment's access to one app store: its App
Store Server API key or Google Play service account, sealed by Money and
never returned, and the apps (bundle ids or package names) it covers.

name.description:
`orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/store_connections/{store_connection}`;
by convention `app-store` or `google-play`.

uid.description:
`stc_<cell><ulid>`; never reused. Store notifications for this
connection are sent to a URL that carries it.

sylphx.money.v1.StoreConnectionSpec.description: StoreConnectionSpec is the caller-writable state of a StoreConnection.

allow_sandbox.description:
Accept purchases the store marks as sandbox or license-test. Off: a
sandbox purchase is refused. On a `production` App Store connection it
also takes App Review and TestFlight purchases, read back from the
sandbox and recorded and granted as `sandbox`, never as production.

client_verify.description:
Let an app with no server verify its own purchases against this
connection (`store_purchases:clientVerify`, callable with a publishable
key). Off by default, including for every connection created before this
field existed; only a secret key holding `billing:write` can turn it on.

require_account_token.description:
Refuse a purchase that does not carry the subject's account token (App
Store `appAccountToken`, Play `obfuscatedAccountId`).

sylphx.money.v1.StoreConnectionStatus.description: StoreConnectionStatus is the observed state of a StoreConnection.

conditions.description: Ready when a credential is stored.

notification_url.description: Where the store sends its notifications for this connection.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

service_account_email.description: The service account's email, read from the stored key (Play only).

sylphx.money.v1.StorePurchase.description:
A Store Purchase is one store transaction Money verified with the store and
bound to one subject. Re-verifying it returns the same record and grant.

bundle_or_package.description: The bundle id or package name.

claw_back.description:
Revoked after it was delivered, and its goods come back: its
entitlements ended, and the app takes back the assets its grant credited,
up to what the subject still holds. False while it stands, and for a
refund the catalog's `refund_claw_back` lets the subject keep.

customer_subscription.description: The subscription it belongs to, for a subscription purchase.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/store_purchases/{store_purchase}`.

original_purchase_time.description:
When the store says the first purchase of this subscription or restored
purchase was made; unset when it did not report one.

original_transaction_id.description: The first transaction of a subscription or restored purchase.

price.description:
The price the store charged, in minor units of `currency`, when the store
reports it.

product.description: The catalog product it sells, when the catalog maps the store product.

purchase_time.description: When the store says it was bought.

region_code.description:
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the buyer's storefront, upper case; empty
when the store did not report one.

revoke_time.description: When the store refunded or revoked it.

transaction_id.description: The store's transaction id (App Store transaction id, Play order id).

sylphx.money.v1.Subject.description:
A Subject is who pays and holds entitlements: exactly one of an end user
or a customer organization of the app.

end_user.description: An end user's id (Sylphx Auth, or the app's own OIDC issuer).

name.description: The catalog to push.

sylphx.money.v1.TaxThresholdStatus.description:
A Tax Threshold Status is where the environment's consumer (B2C) paid
sales stand against one jurisdiction's registration threshold for digital
services (docs/services/money/web-payments.md, "Tax registration
thresholds"). It is computed on read from the sales Money recorded and the
threshold table; nothing about it is written by a caller.

alerted_percent.description:
The highest alert level (70, 90, 100) already sent for this window; 0 if
none.

effective_time.description: When the threshold row took effect.

meta.description: Resource metadata; not set for a computed view.

name.description:
`orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/tax_threshold_statuses/{threshold}`,
the threshold's id (`au-gst`, `us-tx`).

percent.description:
How close the sales are to the threshold, in whole percent (the higher of
the amount and the count); it can exceed 100.

region_code.description: The jurisdiction's country, upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

sales_amount.description:
The consumer paid sales in the window, net of tax, in `currency_code`
minor units. Business sales (a tax id was given) are excluded.

source_url.description: The authority page the threshold comes from.

subdivision_code.description: The jurisdiction's subdivision (a US state, `TX`); empty for a country.

tax_name.description: The tax the threshold registers for, for example `GST`.

threshold_amount.description:
The amount that triggers registration, integer minor units of
`currency_code`; "0" when the threshold is a transaction count only.

threshold_transaction_count.description: The transaction count that triggers registration; 0 when none.

unconverted_currency_codes.description:
Currencies of sales that could not be converted into `currency_code`
(no rate in the rate table) and so are not counted in `sales_amount`.

window_end_time.description: The end of the window (the moment of the read for a rolling window).

window_start_time.description: The start (inclusive) of the window the figures below cover.

sylphx.money.v1.UnconvertedAmount.description: An amount a summary could not convert yet.

amount.description: In minor units of that currency.

allow_missing.description: Create the catalog when it does not exist (declarative upsert).

catalog.description: The catalog to write; `name` identifies it.

update_mask.description: The fields to write; unset writes every populated field.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

allow_missing.description: Create the policy when it does not exist (declarative upsert).

checkout_policy.description: The checkout policy to write; `name` identifies it.

update_mask.description: The fields to write; unset writes every populated field.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

name.description: The subscription to change.

proration_behavior.description: How the change is billed; unspecified is `create_prorations`.

quantity.description:
The new quantity (seats) of the subscription's one item; at least 1.
To end the subscription, cancel it.

merchant_account.description: The merchant account with its new values; `name` selects it.

update_mask.description: The fields to change.

revenue_source.description: The source with its new values; `name` addresses it.

update_mask.description:
The fields to change: `spec.display_name`, `spec.paused`,
`spec.config`. Empty changes every one the body sets.

validate_only.description: Validate only; write nothing.

allow_missing.description: Create the store connection when it does not exist (declarative upsert).

store_connection.description: The store connection to update; `name` identifies it.

update_mask.description: The fields to write; unset writes every populated field.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

update_mask.description: The fields to change.

usage_meter.description: The usage meter with its new values; `name` selects it.

update_mask.description: The fields to change.

usage_settings.description: The usage settings with its new values; `name` selects it.

update_mask.description: The fields to change.

usage_tier.description: The usage tier with its new values; `name` selects it.

sylphx.money.v1.UsageEvent.description:
A Usage Event is rated usage, immutable: what a settled reservation or a
direct record produced.

amount_nano.description: The rated amount, nano-minor, a decimal string.

late.description: Settled after the reservation expired; the usage is still recorded.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/usage_events/{usage_event}`.

quantity.description: How much, in the meter's base unit.

usage_reservation.description: The reservation it settled, when it did.

sylphx.money.v1.UsageInvoice.description:
A Usage Invoice is Money's own invoice for a subject's usage. A `threshold`
invoice is cut mid-month; the `period` invoice nets those off.

gross_minor.description: The amounts, minor units, decimal strings.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/usage_invoices/{usage_invoice}`.

tax_pending_reason.description: Why it is not issued yet, when `tax_pending` (for example `location_required`, `grant_tax_treatment`).

total_minor.description: What is owed: subtotal plus tax minus post-tax credit.

sylphx.money.v1.UsageMeter.description:
A Usage Meter names one kind of usage a merchant bills for: its unit and
whether usage may be recorded without a reservation. The merchant creates
and changes it through this API; its prices are `UsageMeterPrice` records.

active.description: A retired meter (false) refuses new usage; its history stays.

current_unit_price_nano.description:
The unit price in force now, nano-minor, a decimal string; empty before
the meter's first price.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/usage_meters/{usage_meter}`; the id is the meter key.

reservation_optional.description: Whether usage may be recorded without a reservation.

unit.description:
The unit of one quantity, for example `token`. It cannot change once the
meter has recorded usage.

sylphx.money.v1.UsageMeterPrice.description:
A Usage Meter Price is one entry of a meter's append-only price history. A
price applies from `effective_time` on, so a change never rewrites usage
already rated.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217; it must be the environment's currency.

effective_time.description:
When it starts applying; now when absent. Not in the past, and after the
meter's latest price.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/usage_meter_prices/{usage_meter_price}`.

tax_code.description: The processor's tax code for the usage line; empty for the merchant's default.

unit_price_nano.description: List price of one unit, nano-minor (a billionth of a minor unit), a decimal string.

sylphx.money.v1.UsageReservation.description:
A Usage Reservation holds usage before the work starts. Settling it records
what was used and releases the rest; releasing it records nothing.

actor_proof.description:
For a customer organization: the token of the acting user, whose
membership of the organization is checked fresh. The subject is Sylphx
Auth's bare organization id (`acme`), never a resource name. Never stored.

dark_refusal.description:
While enforcement is dark: why it would have been refused
(`spend_limit_reached`, `no_payment_method`, `account_suspended`); empty otherwise.

expire_time.description: When the hold ends.

granted_quantity.description: What was granted: at most `max_quantity`, less under headroom.

max_quantity.description: The most the work may use, in the meter's base unit.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/usage_reservations/{usage_reservation}`.

subject_proof.description:
The acting end user's access token, required on every reserve: Money
proves the subject itself, fresh, with the caller's own key
(`auth:sessions:verify`) or the merchant's configured issuer. Never
stored. A raw id is refused with PERMISSION_DENIED (reason `subject_unverified`).

ttl.description: How long the hold lasts, at most `600s`; default `600s`.

sylphx.money.v1.UsageSettings.description:
Usage Settings is the environment's usage-billing account: its currency, the
enforcement switch (dark until a merchant admin turns it on), the free
allowance, the dunning schedule and an extra token issuer. One per
environment (AIP-156 singleton, id `default`).

currency_code.description: The currency usage is rated and invoiced in (ISO 4217, upper case).

enforcement_enabled.description:
While false a reservation is always granted and a would-be refusal is
only recorded. Off until the merchant's admin turns it on.

extra_issuer.description:
A further token issuer (the merchant's own OIDC provider) besides Sylphx
Auth; empty for Sylphx Auth only. It needs `extra_issuer_jwks_url`.

extra_issuer_audience.description: The audience that issuer's tokens must carry; required with `extra_issuer`.

extra_issuer_org_claim.description:
The claim that names a customer organization in that issuer's tokens;
empty means the issuer proves no organization subject.

free_allowance_nano.description:
What a subject with no payment method may use each month, nano-minor,
as a decimal string.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/usage_settings/default`.

past_due_grace_days.description: Days after an invoice's due time before the subject is past due.

suspend_grace_days.description: Days after an invoice's due time before the subject is suspended.

headroom_minor.description:
What the subject may still use now, minor units, a decimal string; empty
when it has no limit.

payment_method_on_file.description: Whether a payment method is on file.

threshold_minor.description: The amount that makes a threshold invoice be cut, minor units.

sylphx.money.v1.UsageTier.description:
A Usage Tier is a trust tier of the merchant's own: the limits a subject
starts at and rises to with payment history. Rank 0 is the base tier.

daily_limit_minor.description: Daily exposure limit in minor units, a decimal string; empty for none.

monthly_limit_minor.description: Monthly exposure limit in minor units, a decimal string; empty for none.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/usage_tiers/{usage_tier}`; the id is the tier key.

rank.description: Order of tiers; 0 is the base tier.

requires_paid_invoices.description: Paid invoices needed to reach this tier.

requires_paid_minor.description: Paid total, minor units, needed to reach this tier.

threshold_minor.description: The amount an invoice would make due at which a threshold invoice is cut.

bundle_id.description: App Store, with `transaction_id`: the app's bundle id.

package_name.description: Google Play: the package name, when the connection covers several.

parent.description: The environment the purchase is verified in.

product_id.description: Google Play: the store product id (for a subscription, its id).

signed_transaction.description: App Store: the StoreKit 2 signed transaction (`jwsRepresentation`).

transaction_id.description:
App Store, instead of `signed_transaction`: the transaction id, for apps
on original StoreKit whose receipts carry no signed transaction. Money
reads the transaction from Apple with the connection's key; Apple's
signed answer is the proof.

validate_only.description:
Verify fully and return the verdict Money would give, without writing
anything: no record, no subject binding, no Google Play acknowledge or
consume, no entitlement, no ledger posting, no event, and no signed
`grant_token`. Refusals are exactly the ones a real call gives. For
moving existing store sales onto Money, by comparing verdicts with the
seller's own path before switching.

already_verified.description:
Whether this transaction was verified before; the record and grant are
the same.

customer_subscription.description: The subscription, for a subscription purchase.

grant_claims.description:
With `validate_only`, the claims the grant would carry (the same JSON a
signed `grant_token` holds); empty otherwise.

grant_token.description:
A compact EdDSA JWS (`typ` `money-grant+jwt`) the app's server or client
verifies offline against Money's published keys; it names the subject,
the store product, the transaction, the quantity, and the catalog grants.

store_completion.description:
`ClientVerifyStorePurchase` only: what Money did to finish the purchase
with the store: `acknowledged`, `consumed`, or `retry` (the store call
failed; call again later). Empty on `VerifyStorePurchase`.

transferred.description:
`ClientVerifyStorePurchase` only: the purchase moved from another install
to the caller (restore). Always false until restore transfer is served.

sylphx.network.v1.Certificate.description:
A Certificate covers names Sylphx terminates itself (the data door and
origin). It is read-only to customers; customer hostnames on the web door
are served by the edge without one. Its private key is a secret in Sylphx
Secrets that nobody reads back.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/certificates/{certificate}`.

sylphx.network.v1.CertificateIssuer.description: CertificateIssuer is who signs a certificate.

sylphx.network.v1.CertificateSpec.description: CertificateSpec is the caller-writable state of a Certificate.

sylphx.network.v1.CertificateStatus.description: CertificateStatus is the observed state of a Certificate.

expire_time.description: When the served certificate expires.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

renewal_window_end_time.description: When the CA's renewal window closes.

renewal_window_start_time.description: When the CA's renewal window opens.

domain.description: The domain to create; only spec and caller-writable metadata are read.

domain_id.description: The id segment of the name; the server assigns one when unset.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

egress_identity.description:
The egress identity to create; only spec and caller-writable metadata are
read.

egress_identity_id.description: The id segment of the name; the server assigns one when unset.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

private_link.description:
The private link to create; only spec and caller-writable metadata are
read.

private_link_id.description: The id segment of the name; the server assigns one when unset.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

route.description: The route to create; only spec and caller-writable metadata are read.

route_id.description: The id segment of the name; the server assigns one when unset.

validate_only.description: Validate and return the result without writing anything.

allow_missing.description: Succeed when the Resource does not exist.

etag.description: Delete only if the current etag matches.

name.description: The name of the domain to delete.

validate_only.description: Validate without deleting anything.

allow_missing.description: Succeed when the Resource does not exist.

etag.description: Delete only if the current etag matches.

name.description: The name of the egress identity to delete.

validate_only.description: Validate without deleting anything.

allow_missing.description: Succeed when the Resource does not exist.

etag.description: Delete only if the current etag matches.

name.description: The name of the private link to delete.

validate_only.description: Validate without deleting anything.

allow_missing.description: Succeed when the Resource does not exist.

etag.description: Delete only if the current etag matches.

name.description: The name of the route to delete.

validate_only.description: Validate without deleting anything.

sylphx.network.v1.Domain.description:
A Domain is a name a project controls. It is verified once, before any
certificate or Route uses it; verification is fail-closed. The id is the
domain with dots as dashes; `spec.domain_name` is the name itself.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/domains/{domain}`.

sylphx.network.v1.DomainSpec.description: DomainSpec is the caller-writable state of a Domain.

domain_name.description:
The fully qualified name, for example `example.com`. Wildcards are
refused.

verification_method.description: How control is proven; default TXT.

sylphx.network.v1.DomainStatus.description: DomainStatus is the observed state of a Domain.

observed_generation.description: The generation this status was computed from.

sylphx.network.v1.DomainVerification.description:
DomainVerification is the record a caller publishes to prove control of a
domain.

record_name.description: The DNS name to publish, for example `_sylphx-verify.example.com`.

sylphx.network.v1.EdgeState.description: EdgeState is the progress of a hostname at the edge.

sylphx.network.v1.EgressIdentity.description:

sylphx.notify.v1.EmailDomain.description:
An Email Domain is an email domain Notify sends from and receives for. It
sends only after its DKIM and SPF records verify; every email is DKIM-signed
with the domain's non-exportable key from Sylphx Keys, rotated with overlap. It
receives only after every MX record of the domain points at the platform.
No key material is ever returned.

sylphx.notify.v1.InboundEmail.description:
An Inbound Email is one mail a mailbox holds, received or sent, kept as
evidence: parsed once, never changed except by erasure. Consumers read the
feed in `sequence` order.

automated.description:
Sent by software: Auto-Submitted, Precedence bulk or list, auto-reply
headers, or a delivery report.

direction.description: Received by the mailbox, or found in its Sent folder.

erased.description: Personal data removed by erasure; the dedupe key stays.

html_body.description: The HTML body as received; render it only through a sanitizer.

message.description: The Notify Message that sent it, for mail Notify sent as this mailbox.

message_id.description:
The Message-ID without angle brackets; the dedupe key. Mail without one
gets `sha256-<hex>@invalid`.

name.description: `orgs/{org}/projects/{project}/envs/{env}/mailboxes/{mailbox}/inbound_emails/{inbound_email}`.

parent_message_id.description: In-Reply-To: the Message-ID this answers, without angle brackets.

raw_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw message, hex.

receive_time.description: The Date header, else when the mailbox received it.

sequence.description:
The feed position, increasing within the environment; filter
`sequence > N` to resume after the last one handled.

sylphx.notify.v1.InboundEmailDirection.description: Whether an Inbound Email came in or went out.
